details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
aux. 构成疑问句和否定句; 代替动词; 用于加强语气
vt. 做; 干; 进行; 从事
vi. 表现; 进展; 引起; 行过
n. 社交聚会; 社交活动; 宴会
时态：did, done, doing, does
→来自dhe, 做，制造，放置，词源同fact, theme.
aux.v.vt.做,干,办,从事;引起vi.行动What are you doing?你在做什么?
[du] [du:] (did, done)
auxiliary verb
FOR QUESTIONS/NEGATIVES 用于疑问句／否定句
ESSENTIAL
■used with another verb to form questions and negative sentences, including negative orders, and sometimes in affirmative sentences for reasons of style （与另一动词连用构成疑问句和否定句，包括倒装句，有时因文体原因亦可用于肯定句）
•Where do you work?你在哪里上班？
•Why did you do that?你为甚么那么做？
•Why don't we have lunch together on Friday?我们周五何不一起吃午饭呢？
•Doesn't Matthew look old these days?这些天马修是不是看起来有些老？
•"Didn't you realise she was deaf?" "No I didn't."/"Of course I did."“你没发现她耳聋吗?”“没有。”／“当然发现了。”
•Not only did I speak to her, I even got her autograph!我不仅和她说了话，而且还得到了她的亲笔签名。
•formal Never did I hear such a terrible noise.我从没听到过如此可怕的噪音。
•Don't (you) speak to me like that!（你）别和我这样说话！
•UK Don't let's argue about it (= Let's not argue about it).这件事我们不要再争了。
•formal So quietly did she speak (= She spoke so quietly) that I could scarcely hear her.她说话的声音太小，我几乎听不到。
•Little does he know (= He knows nothing about it) , but we're flying to Geneva next weekend to celebrate his birthday.他还不知道呢，下周末我们要飞往日内瓦去给他庆祝生日。
•"I want three cakes, two chocolate bars and an ice cream." "Do you now/indeed ? (= That is surprising or unreasonable)."“我要三件蛋糕、两条巧克力棒和一个雪糕。”“你现在就要／真的要吗？”
ESSENTIAL
■used instead of the main verb in questions that are added to the end of a sentence to check information （在用来确认资讯的疑问句中代替主要动词）
•You met him at our dinner party, didn't you?晚餐会上你和他见过面，对不对？
•You don't understand the question, do you?你没理解这个问题，是吗？
ESSENTIAL
■used instead of the main verb in questions that are added to the end of a sentence as a way of expressing surprise （在表示惊奇的疑问句中代替主要动词）
•So Susannah and Guy finally got married, did they?苏珊娜和盖伊终于结婚了，是吗？
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
auxiliary verb
TO AVOID REPEATING 避免重复
ESSENTIAL
■used to avoid repeating a verb or verb phrase （用于避免动词或动词短语的重复）
•She runs much faster than he does.她跑得比他快多了。
•Maria looks much healthier than she did.玛丽亚看起来比过去健康了许多。
•"I don't like intense heat." " Nor/Neither do I."“我不喜欢酷热的天气。”“我也是。”
•"I hate intense heat." " So do I."“我讨厌炎热的天气。”“我也是。”
•"You left your umbrella." " So I did. I'm becoming so forgetful these days."“你忘了拿雨伞。”“还真是，这些天我有些健忘。”
•"Would you mind tidying up the kitchen?" mainly UK"I have done already./I already have done."“你愿意收拾一下厨房吗？”“我已经收拾过了。”
•"May I join you?" "Please do!"“我可以加入你们吗?”“请吧！”
•"Who said that?" "I did."“谁说的?”“我。”
•"Tilly speaks fluent Japanese." "Does she really?"“蒂丽日语说得很流利。”“真的吗?”
•"I thought I'd take a day off school today." "Oh no you don't (= I'm not going to let you do that) !"“我本想今天请一天假不上学了。”“哦，那可不行！”
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
auxiliary verb
FOR EMPHASIS 用于强调
IMPROVER [+ infinitive without to]
■used to give extra force to the main verb （用于强调主要动词）
•Do shut up, Georgia, and get on with your homework.千万别说了，乔治娅，赶紧做功课吧。
•Do write and let me know how you're getting on.务必写信告诉我你的情况。
•"Can I buy stamps here?" "Well, we do sell them, but we haven't got any at the moment."“我能在这儿买些邮票吗？”“我们这里确实卖邮票，但现在没货。”
•He cooks a lot does Alex. He does far more than me.亚历克斯常做饭，他比我做的次数多得多。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
PERFORM 执行
ESSENTIAL transitive
■to perform, take part in or achieve something 做；履行；执行
•That was a really stupid thing to do.那么做真是太愚蠢了。
•Why were you sent home from school early? What have you done now?你为甚么放学这么早？你又干了甚么事？
•What are you doing over the weekend?这周末你准备干甚么？
•The only thing we can do now is wait and see what happens.我们现在唯一能做的就是坐观事态发展。
•You should be able to do it by yourself/on your own.你自己应该能做到。
•What have you done (= caused to happen) to her?你对她都干了些甚么？
•What (on Earth) were you doing in the library (= Why were you there and what action were you performing) at two o'clock in the morning?凌晨两点钟你（到底）在图书馆干甚么？
•What are these toys doing here (= Why are they here) ?这些玩具放在这里干甚么？
•What do you do (for a living) (= What is your job) ?你做甚么工作？
•What can I do for you (= How can I help you) ?我能为您做些甚么？
•What have you done with (= Where have you put) my coat? Have you hidden it?你把我的外套弄哪里去了? 你给藏起来了吗？
•She just hasn't known what to do with herself (= how to keep herself busy) since she retired.自从退休以后，她一直都不知道该干些甚么。
do sth about sth
■to take action to deal with something 对…采取行动
•It's a global problem - what can individuals do about it?这是全球性的问题——个人能为此做些甚么？
do well/badly by sb formal
■to treat someone well or badly 招待（某人）周全／不周
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
ACT 行动
ESSENTIAL intransitive or transitive
■to act or take action 干，行动
•Stop arguing with me, Daryl, and do as you're told!别再和我争辩了，达里尔，叫你干甚么你就干甚么！
•She told me not to ask any questions, just to do as she did.她叫我不要问任何问题，只管像她那样去干就行了。
•"Was it wrong of me to go to the police?" "Oh no, I'm sure you did right/did the right thing."“我去找员警不对吗？”“哦，不，我肯定你干的没错。”
•You'd do well to take some professional advice on this matter.在这件事上听听专业人士的意见会大有裨益。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
CONNECTED 与…相关
to do with
ADVANCED
■connected with 与…相关
•"Why did you want to talk to me?" "Well, it's to do with a complaint that's been made about your work."“为甚么你要跟我谈话?”“因为这涉及到一件对你工作的投诉。”
•"But I didn't have any money." "What has that got to do with it? You still shouldn't have taken my purse without asking me."“可是我没有钱了。”“那和这件事有甚么关系?你还是不应该不问自取拿走我的钱包呀。”
•She's refused to have anything (more) to do with him since he was arrested for drinking and driving.自从他因酒后驾车被捕后，她就拒绝与他（再）有任何联系。
•"I thought I should tell you I saw your son smoking today." "Mind your own business, would you? It has nothing to do with you what my son does!"“我今天看见你儿子抽烟了，我觉得应该把这件事告诉你。”“你还是管好自己的事吧，行不行？我儿子做甚么和你一点关系都没有！”
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
DEAL WITH 处理
ESSENTIAL transitive
■to deal with; to be responsible for 处理；对…负责
•Lucia is going to do the publicity for the school play.露西娅将负责这部校园剧的宣传工作。
•If they ask any awkward questions, just let me do the talking.一旦他们提出棘手的问题，就让我来负责回答。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
STUDY 研究
IMPROVER transitive
■to study a subject 研究，学习，读（专业）
•Diane did anthropology at university.戴安娜在大学读的是人类学。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
SOLVE 解决
IMPROVER transitive
■to solve, or find the answer to something 解决；解答；回答
•to do a puzzle玩智力游戏
•I've never been able to do crosswords.我从来不会玩填字游戏。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
MAKE 制作
IMPROVER transitive
■to make, produce or create something 制作，生产，创作
•I can't come out tonight - I've got to do my history essay.今晚我不能出去——我得把历史课的论文写出来。
•[+ two objects] Can you do me 20 photocopies of this report/do 20 photocopies of this report for me?你能把这份报告给我复印20份吗？
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
FINISH 完成
ADVANCED intransitive
■If you say that you have done with something or someone, or have done performing a particular action, you mean that you have finished what you were doing with something or someone, or what you were saying to someone, or that you have finished the action 结束，完成
•Have you done with those scissors yet?你用完剪刀了吗？
•Where the hell are you going? I haven't done with you yet.你到底想去哪里？我跟你还没说完呢。
•[+ -ing verb] I haven't done talking to you yet.我跟你还没说完呢。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
CLEAN/MAKE TIDY 打扫／整理
ADVANCED intransitive or transitive
■to clean or tidy, or make something look attractive 打扫，清洁；整理；装饰
■1. I want to do (= clean) the living room this afternoon.
do 1 今天下午我要打扫一下客厅。
•I cooked the dinner so you can do (= wash) the dishes.我做了晚饭，所以你来洗碗吧。
•do your hair/make-up/nails做头发／化妆／修指甲
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
ARRANGE 安排
ADVANCED transitive
■to arrange something 安排，排列，安放
•You've done those flowers beautifully.你把那些花儿插得真漂亮。
•Can anyone here do (= tie) bow-ties?这里有人会打领结吗？
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
TRAVEL 旅行
ADVANCED transitive
■to travel a particular distance or to travel at a particular speed 走过，旅行过（一段路程）；以…速度行进
•It's an old car and it's done over 80 000 miles.这是一辆旧车，已经跑了八万多英里。
•My new car does 50 miles to the gallon/30 km to the litre uses one gallon of fuel to travel 50 miles, or one litre to travel 30 km.我的新车一加仑汽油能跑50英里／一升汽油能跑30公里。
•We were doing 150 (km an hour) along the motorway.我们以每小时150公里的速度在高速公路上行驶。
ADVANCED transitive
■to complete a journey 完成（一段旅程）
•We did the journey to Wales in five hours.我们用五小时走完了到威尔士的路程。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
BE ACCEPTABLE 可以接受
ADVANCED intransitive or transitive
■to be acceptable, suitable or enough (for) 可以接受；适合；够用
•Will this room do or would you prefer one with a shower?这个房间行吗？还是你想要个带淋浴间的房间？
•This kind of behaviour just won't do.这种行为根本不能接受。
•[+ to infinitive] It doesn't do to criticize your parents.不可以批评父母。
•I haven't got any grapefruit juice, but I've got some orange juice. Will that do (you)?我没有葡萄柚汁，但有一些柳橙汁。（你）要吗？
•"Is that enough potato, or would you like some more?" "That'll do (= be enough for) me, thanks."“那些马铃薯够吗?你还要吗?”“我要那些就够了，谢谢。”
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
CAUSE TO HAVE 使拥有
ADVANCED transitive
■to provide or sell something, or to cause someone to have something 提供；销售；供给
•There's a special offer on and they're doing three for the price of two.现在他们正在特价优惠中，花两件的价钱可以买三件。
•Do you do travel insurance as well as flights?除了飞行以外你们提供旅游保险吗？
•The pub only does food at lunchtimes, not in the evenings.这家酒馆只在午饭时提供食物，晚饭时没有。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
COOK 烹饪
ADVANCED transitive
■to cook or prepare food 做（饭），烹制，准备（食物）
•Who's doing the food for your party?谁为你的派对准备食品？
•[+ two objects] I'll do you some scrambled eggs.我来给你做点炒鸡蛋。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
MANAGE 设法
ADVANCED intransitive usually + adverb
■to develop or continue with the stated amount of success; to manage 进展；继续保持；设法做到
•How is Mary doing in her new job/school?玛丽在新的工作岗位上表现／在新学校里学得怎么样？
•Both the new mother and her baby are doing very well.产妇和新生儿目前都状况良好。
•Are your roses doing all right this year?今年你的玫瑰长得好吗？
•Many shops are doing badly because of the economic situation.由于目前的经济形势，很多商店都处于惨淡经营的状态。
•I did rather well when I traded in my car - they gave me a good price for it.我做的折旧贴换新车很划算——他们给我的旧车出了个好价钱。
•Alexa has done well for her self (= has achieved great personal success) , getting such a highly paid job.亚历克莎得到这样一份高薪的工作，干得真不错。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
PLAY 扮演
transitive
■to perform a play or to play the part of a character 演出；扮演
•The children are doing a play at the end of term.期末孩子们要演戏。
•She's done all the important Shakespearean roles apart from Lady Macbeth.她扮演过莎士比亚戏剧中除马克白夫人以外的所有重要角色。
•I hope she doesn't do a Helen (= do what Helen did) and get divorced six months after her wedding.我希望她不要像海伦那样结婚六个月就离婚。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
VISIT 参观
transitive informal
■to visit the interesting places in a town or country, or to look around an interesting place 参观，游览
•We didn't manage to do Nice when we were in France.我们在法国时没能去尼斯游览。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
STEAL 偷窃
transitive informal
■to enter a building illegally and steal from it （入室）盗窃，偷盗
•Our house was done while we were away.我们外出时家中失窃了。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
CHEAT 欺骗
transitive informal
■to cheat someone 欺骗，欺诈；骗取
•Fifty bucks for that old bike! You've been done!那辆旧脚踏车花了50美元！你上当了！
•He did me for a thousand quid for that car.他那辆汽车骗了我1000英镑。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
PRISON 监狱
transitive informal
■to spend time in prison 服刑，坐牢
•He did three years for his part in the robbery.他因参与抢劫坐了三年牢。
•If you're not careful you'll end up doing time again.如果不小心你还会再进监狱。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
PUNISH 惩罚
transitive mainly UK informal
■to punish someone 惩罚，处罚
•If you mess with me again, I'll do you good and proper.你如果再跟我捣乱，我可要好好治治你了。
•I got done (= stopped by the police) for speeding on my way home last night.昨晚回家时，我超速驾驶被员警截住了。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
TAKE DRUG 吸毒
transitive informal
■to take an illegal drug 服用（毒品），吸（毒）
•How long have you been doing heroin?你服用海洛因有多久了？
•I don't do drugs.我不吸毒。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
HAPPEN 发生
be doing informal
■to be happening 发生
•This town is so boring in the evening - there's never anything doing.晚上这座城镇很无聊——从来都没有甚么事情发生。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
can't be doing with sth UK informal
■to be unable to bear something, or to have no patience with it 无法忍受，不能容忍；对…没有耐心
•I can't be doing with all this shouting and screaming.我受不了这样又喊又叫。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
Do as you would be done by. saying
■said to show that you believe in treating others as you would like them to treat you 己所不欲，勿施于人。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
do it informal
■to have sex 发生性关系，做爱
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
do something/nothing, etc. for/to sb informal
■to have/not have a strong and positive effect on someone, or to be/not be something or someone that they like or enjoy 对／不对（某人）有正面影响；为／不为（某人）所喜爱
•Watching that film really did something to me.看了那部电影我还真的有些收获。
•Chopin has never really done it/anything for me.萧邦从来没有对我产生过甚么影响。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
That does it!
■said when someone or something goes beyond the limit of what is acceptable 太不像话了！
•That does it! I will not tolerate that sort of behaviour in this class.太不像话了！我不能容忍这个班里出现这样的行为。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
That will never do! old-fashioned
■used to say that a situation is wrong and unacceptable 绝对不行！
■1. "The dinner was excellent except that they served red wine with the chicken." "Dear me! That will never do!"
do 2 “晚餐很棒，只是不该用红酒配鸡肉。”“天啊！那怎么行啊！”
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
That'll do!
■used to tell someone to stop behaving badly 够了！行了！
•That'll do, Timothy! Please just sit down and keep quiet.够了，蒂莫西！请坐下别说话。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
That's done it! informal
■said when someone or something has caused damage or a difficulty 这可糟了！
•"That's done it!" said Anna as she looked at the damage. "Now I really will have to get a new car."“这可糟了！”安娜看着损坏的地方说，“看来我真得买辆新汽车了。”
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done)
What's done is done. saying
■said when you cannot change something that has already happened 事已至此。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs do away with sth
■to get rid of something or stop using something 摆脱，抛弃；废除
•These ridiculous rules and regulations should have been done away with years ago.这些荒唐的规章制度几年前就该废除了。
•Computerization has enabled us to do away with a lot of paperwork.电脑的广泛应用让我们摆脱了很多文书工作。
•How on Earth could they do away with a lovely old building like that and put a car park there instead?他们怎么能拆掉一座那样漂亮的老建筑去修建停车场呢？
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs do away with sb informal
■to murder someone 干掉（某人），杀死（某人）
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs do sb down
■to criticize someone in order to make them feel ashamed or to make other people lose respect for them 羞辱（某人）；贬低（某人）
•She felt that everyone in the meeting was trying to do her down.她觉得会上每一个人都在试图羞辱她。
•[R] Stop doing your self down.别再眨低你自己了。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs do for sb/sth UK old-fashioned informal
■to seriously damage something, or to seriously hurt or kill someone 严重损坏；严重伤害；杀死
•Driving on those rough roads has really done for my car.在那种崎岖的路上行驶对我的汽车磨损很严重。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs do sth for sb/sth
■If a doctor of medicine does something for someone or their illness, they make them better 治愈；使好转
•Can you do anything for my bad back, doctor?医生，你能治一治我的背痛吗？
•These pills I've been taking have done nothing for me.我一直吃的这些药丸对我一点用都没有。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs do sb in
KILL slang
■to attack or kill someone 袭击（某人），干掉（某人），杀死（某人）
•They threatened to do me in if I didn't pay up by Friday.他们威胁说如果我周五之前不还钱就要杀了我。
TIRE informal
■to make someone extremely tired 使（某人）极劳累，使（某人）极疲惫
•That hockey match really did me in.那场曲棍球比赛真把我给累坏了。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs [R] do yourself in slang
■to kill yourself 自杀
•She threatened to do herself in when her husband ran off with her best friend.丈夫和她最好的朋友跑了，她扬言说自己不想活了。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs [M] do sth out UK informal
■to clean or tidy something 清洁，打扫；整理
•I'd like you to do out your room before Chris comes to stay.我希望你在克里斯来住之前把你的房间打扫干净。
■to decorate something 装饰，装点，布置
•They did the room out with balloons and streamers ready for the party.他们为了派对把房间用气球和彩带装饰起来。
•We've had the bathroom done out in pale yellow.我们让人把浴室刷成了浅黄色。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs do sb out of sth informal
■to stop someone from getting or keeping something, especially in a dishonest or unfair way （尤指以不诚实或不公正的手段）使（某人）蒙受损失；骗取，骗走
•Pensioners have been done out of millions of pounds as a result of the changes.这些变革使领取养老金者损失了数百万英镑。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs [M] do sb over mainly UK informal
■to attack someone violently 猛烈攻击（某人），狠揍（某人）
•They said they'd do me over if I refused to drive the getaway car.他们说如果我拒绝开车带他们逃走，他们就要狠揍我一顿。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs do sth over US
■to do something again because you did not do it well the first time 重做
•This essay's the worst you've ever done. I think you should do it over.这篇论文是你写得最差的一篇。我觉得你应该重写。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs [M] do (sth) up
ESSENTIAL
■to fasten something or become fastened 系牢
•Can you help me to do up my dress?你能帮我把衣服扣上吗？
•Do your shoes/laces up before you trip over.把鞋带系好，免得绊倒。
•These trousers must have shrunk - I can't do the zip up.这条裤子一定是缩水了——我都拉不上拉链了。
•Why won't this zip do up?这条拉链为甚么拉不上？
Opposite undo
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs [M] do sth up
REPAIR
ADVANCED
■to repair or decorate a building so that it looks attractive 整修；装修，装饰
•I'd like to buy a run-down cottage that I can do up.我想买一个破旧的小屋自己装修一下。
WRAP
■to wrap something in paper 包装，包裹
•She always does her presents up beautifully in gold and silver paper.她总是用金银纸把礼物包装得非常精美。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
verb[duː](did, done) Phrasal Verbs do without (sth)
IMPROVER
■to manage without having something 凑合，应付，将就
•There's no mayonnaise left, so I'm afraid you'll just have to do without.蛋黄酱用完了，恐怕你只得将就着不用它了。
•Thank you Kate, we can do without language like that (= we don't want to hear your rude language).谢谢你，凯特，其实用不着跟我们那样说话。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
noun countable /duː](plural dos)
TREATMENT 对待 UK informal
■a way of treating people 对待，待人
•There are no special privileges for the managers - we believe in fair dos all round (= equal treatment for everyone) in this company.经理没有任何特权——在这间公司里我们讲究人人平等。
■2. It's a poor do (= a bad/unfair situation) when a so-called developed country can't even provide homes for all its citizens.
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
noun countable /duː](plural dos)
RULE 规定
dos and don'ts
■rules about what you must do and must not do in a particular situation 有关在特定场合的行为准则的规定
•In the back of the guide there's a list of the dos and don'ts of local etiquette.指南后面有一个当地礼节规定的清单。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
noun countable /duː](plural dos)
PARTY 聚会
do 3 mainly UK informal
* a party or other social event 派对，社交活动
•Julie's having a bit of a do for her fortieth birthday.朱莉要搞一个类似派对的活动来庆祝她的40岁生日。
•It was one of those dos where nobody really knew each other.那是一次来宾们相互都不认识的社交活动。
[də] [du] [du:] (did, done)
noun countable /duː](plural dos)
HAIR 头发 US for hairdo
execute, conduct, do, perform, fulfil
这组词都有“做，执行，实施，完成”的意思，其区别是：
execute: 指需专门技术熟练技巧去完成某种复杂的任务或表演等，也指用行动把计划或打算付诸实施或执行某项命令。
conduct: 和perform一样比较正式，二者意义相近，但conduct含指导、领导或监督等意味。
do: 最普通常用词，指完成某项具体工作、任务，也指完成某种行为或动作。
perform: 指完成困难较大、较复杂的任务。较正式用词。
fulfil: 指履行和实现所许诺的、所期望或要求的事情，含最终完成的意味。
n. 要求；规定；C大调音阶中的第一音
- requirement, provision, need, desire, demand
vt. 做；进行；完成；解答
- accomplish, carry out, come, achieve, perform
vi. 做；进行；完成
- progress, wage

entries.meaning:
n.码头；船坞；船埠
v.进(港、码头)
entries.example:
The ship's hull scraped along the side of the dock.
船行时船身擦着码头的边。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
The ship's hull scraped along the side of the dock.
船行时船身擦着码头的边。

The cruise ship is strikebound in the dock.
巡洋舰因罢工而停泊在码头上。

The liner is in dock for a refit.
班轮正在船坞修理。

The yacht is lying up in the dock.
那条游艇正停在船坞里。

He rowed up the canal looking for a place to dock the boat.
他在运河里划船，寻找一个码头泊船。

The ferry is expected to dock at 6.
渡船预计在6点停靠码头。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 码头; 被告席; 草本植物; 尾巴的骨肉部份
vt. & vi. （使）船停靠码头; 剪短（尾巴等）; 削减，缩减（工资等）; 在…设置船坞
vi. 入船坞
时态：docked, docking, docks
分布：码头(77%)，船坞(22%)，船埠(1%)
→来自词根duc, 引导，词源同duke, conduct. 用于指码头，船坞。
n.船坞,码头At the dock I'm shocked to see the pocket rocket made of a block of rock.在码头看到一块岩石做的小巧火箭,我感到震惊.
【源】原指：剪掉动物的尾巴而露出的骨头，其形状是一个小的突起，比较向码头延伸出来的样子，就引申为码头了。Doc：Word文档格式，k象一把张开的剪刀－简短
US [dɑ:k] noun
FOR SHIPS 船用
IMPROVER countable
■an area of water in a port that can be closed off and that is used for putting goods onto and taking them off ships or repairing ships 泊位；船坞 Compare harbour
docks
[plural]
■a group of these areas of water in a port and the buildings around them 码头（包括多个泊位和四周的建筑）
•The strike has led to the cancellation of some ferry services and left hundreds of passengers stranded at the docks.罢工导致部分轮度停业，数百名旅客滞留码头。
countable US
■a long platform built over water where passengers can get on or off a boat or where goods can be put on and taken off 码头
UK [dɒk] US [dɑ:k] noun
LAW 法律
the dock only singular mainly UK
■the place in a criminal law court where the accused person sits or stands during the trial 被告席
•The defendant seemed nervous as he left the dock and stepped up to the witness box.被告人在离开被告席走向证人席时似乎有些紧张。
•The company will find itself in the dock (= in court) if it continues to ignore the pollution regulations.如果该公司继续无视控制污染的规定，它就会被告上法庭。
UK [dɒk] US [dɑ:k] noun
PLANT 植物
countable or uncountable
■a common wild plant with large wide leaves which grows in some northern countries such as Britain 酸模
•Rubbing dock leaves on nettle stings helps to relieve the pain.将酸模叶子揉碎抹在荨麻刺伤处有助于止痛。
UK [dɒk] US [dɑ:k] verb
REMOVE 拿走
transitive
■to remove part of something, especially money 克扣，扣发（尤指金钱）
•The University has docked lecturers' pay/wages by 20% because of their refusal to mark examination papers.该大学由于教师们拒绝批改试卷扣发了他们20%的工资。
•The lambs' tails are docked (= cut short) for hygiene reasons.出于卫生方面的考虑，羊的尾巴都被剪短了。
UK [dɒk] US [dɑ:k] verb
SHIP 船
intransitive or transitive
■If a ship docks, it arrives at a dock and if someone docks a ship, they bring it into a dock （使）靠岸，（使）停泊，（使）进港
•Hundreds of people turned up to see the ship dock at Southampton.数百人前来观看该船驶入南安普敦港。
•The Russians and Americans docked (= joined together in space) (their spacecraft) just after one o'clock this morning.俄国人和美国人（的太空船）今天凌晨一点刚过时实现了太空对接。
port, harbor, dock
port: 重心在陆地，包括其所在的城市，port city
harbor: 重心在水，指停泊船只、装卸货物的天然或人工港口，为避风港湾
dock: 码头
n. [水运] 码头； [船] 船坞；被告席；尾巴的骨肉部分
- landing, pier
vt. 使靠码头；剪短
- crop, bob

entries.meaning:
n.博士；医生
v.篡改，伪造；阉割
entries.example:
He is a Doctor of Philosophy.
他是一位哲学博士。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
He is a Doctor of Philosophy.
他是一位哲学博士。

His illness was more serious than the doctor first thought.
他的病较医生原来以为的更严重。

How else can the doctor save him?
医院还有别的方法可以救他吗？

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 医生，大夫; 博士; 神学家; 医疗设备
vt. & vi. 医疗，行医
vt. 修理，装配; 假造; 搀杂; 修改，修饰
时态：doctored, doctoring, doctors
分布：医生(93%)，博士(6%)，阉割(1%)
→来自dek, 接受，得体，匹配，教导，词源同decent, dignity. 原义指老师，尤指宗教导师，学者，神父，后用于指医生和博士。
博士,医生(doct教+or→教的人→有学问的人→博士)[doc,doct=toteach,表示"教"]
n.医生;博士vt.授以博士学位;诊断;修改The doctor's doctrine undid one dollar and a dozen of collars.博士的学说毁掉了一美元和一打衣领.
US ['dɑ:k.tɚ] noun countable
MEDICINE 医学
ESSENTIAL (written abbreviation Dr)
■a person with a medical degree (= university qualification) whose job is to treat people who are ill or hurt 医生，大夫
•The doctor prescribed some pills.医生开了一些药。
•You should see a doctor about that cough.你咳嗽应该找医生看看。
•[as form of address] Good morning, Doctor Smith/Doctor.早上好，史密斯医生／医生。
the doctor's
ESSENTIAL
■the place where a doctor, especially a GP , works 诊所，卫生院
•He went to the doctor's this morning for a checkup.今天上午他去诊所做身体检查。
UK ['dɒk.tər] US ['dɑ:k.tɚ] noun countable
EDUCATION 教育 (written abbreviation Dr)
■a person who has the highest degree (= qualification) from a college or university 博士
UK ['dɒk.tər] US ['dɑ:k.tɚ] noun countable
just what the doctor ordered
■exactly what is wanted or needed 正是想要的东西；正是需要之物
•Ooh thank you, a nice cup of tea. Just what the doctor ordered.噢，谢谢你，这杯茶真好。来得正是时候。
UK ['dɒk.tər] US ['dɑ:k.tɚ] verb transitive
CHANGE 改变
■to change a document in order to deceive people 窜改，涂改
•He was found to have provided the court with doctored evidence.他被发现向法庭提供了窜改过的证据。
■to secretly put a harmful or poisonous substance into food or drink 下（毒），投（毒）
•Bottles of lemonade doctored with rat poison were discovered in the kitchen.厨房里发现了几瓶掺了老鼠药的柠檬汁。
UK ['dɒk.tər] US ['dɑ:k.tɚ] verb transitive
ANIMAL 动物 UK informal
■to remove the sexual organs of an animal in order to prevent it from having babies 阉割（动物）
dentist, surgeon, physician, doctor
这组词都有“医生”的意思，其区别是：
dentist: 指专门从事治牙的医生。
surgeon: 指专修外科或专修人体某个部分的外科专科医生，这种医生一般需对患者进行手术治疗。
physician: 指医院的内科医生。
doctor: 普通用词，泛指各科医生，即一切有行医资格的人。
n. [医] 医生；博士
- medical, hakeem
vt. 修理；窜改，伪造；为…治病；授以博士学位
- repair, perform maintenance
vi. 就医；行医
- practice medicine

entries.meaning:
n.文件；公文；文档
vt.记载；(用文件等)证明
entries.example:
She signed her name to the document.
她在文件上签了名。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
She signed her name to the document.
她在文件上签了名。

He persuaded her to sign the document by guile.
他用欺骗手段说服她在文件上签字。

The official document was misworded.
这公文的措词不当。

A document issued to sub-branches shall be sealed by all the issuers.
联合下发的公文，发文机关都应当加盖印章。

Change Document Display Master Rec.
更改文档显示主记录。

Changes document direction to right-to-left.
将文档方向改为从右向左。

The history of this area is very well documented.
这个地区的历史档案保存得很好。

He can document his theory with facts.
他能为自己的理论提供事实证明。

That's a very interesting claim, but can you document it?
那项要求很有意思，可是你有证件加以证明吗？

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. （计算机）文档，证件; 公文
vt. 证明; 记录; 为…提供证明
时态：documented, documenting, documents
分布：文件(51%)，文档(44%)，公文(4%)，记载(1%)
→来自词根doc, 教，教导，词源同doctor.词义引申为文件，文献。
文件;证书(docu[=doc教]+ment→用来教的东西→文件)[doc,doct=toteach,表示"教"]
n.文档,文件,公文vt.证明They are arguing about the document of the monumental instrument.他们在辩论关于那件不朽乐器的文献.
【参】documentary（n 记录片adj 文件的）；documentation（n 文件）
US [ˈdɑː.kjʊ-]
ESSENTIAL
■a paper or set of papers with written or printed information, especially of an official type （尤指正式的）文件，公文
•official/confidential/legal documents正式／机密／法律档
•They are charged with using forged documents.他们被控使用伪造的档。
ESSENTIAL
■a text that is written and stored on a computer （电脑）文件，文档
•I'll send you the document by email.我会用电子邮件把文件发给你。
verb transitive UK [ˈdɒk.jʊ.mənt/
UK [-ment] US [ˈdɑː.kjʊ-/
■to record the details of an event, a process, etc. 记录，记载
•His interest in cricket has been well- documented (= recorded and written about) by the media.他对板球的兴趣在媒体的报道中都有详细的记载。
record, document, file
record: 记录；
document: 文件，文献
file: 档案，文件；
document, paper
这组词都有“文件”的意思，其区别是：
document: 即可指法律性文件，也可指用作证明或消息来源的文件或记录等。
paper: 普通用词，泛指成册供将来参考或使用的任何文件或公文等。
n. 文件，公文； [计] 文档； [管理] 证件
- file, paper

entries.meaning:
adj.家庭的；国内的；驯养的
n.佣人；家仆
entries.example:
The store deals in objects of domestic utility.
那家商店出售家庭用品。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
The store deals in objects of domestic utility.
那家商店出售家庭用品。

My value for domestic tranquility should much exceed theirs.
我应该远比他们重视家庭的平静生活。

Washington responded by freezing the price of domestic oil.
华盛顿作出的反应是冻结国内的石油价格。

We adopt an active attitude towards drawing on overseas fund to make up for domestic fund shortage.
我们采取积极的态度吸引海外资金以弥补国内资金短缺。

She likes keeping domestic birds.
她喜欢饲养家禽。

His domestics are all in years.
他的佣人全都上了年纪。

entries.meaning: n.门；门口；途径
entries.example:
He chiseled a hole in the door to fit a new lock.
他在门上凿了个孔，以便装一把新锁。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
He chiseled a hole in the door to fit a new lock.
他在门上凿了个孔，以便装一把新锁。

Somebody opened the door and the candle blew out.
有人打开了门，蜡烛随之被吹灭了。

He sprang up and rushed to the door.
他跳起身，跑到门口。

He made for the door and tried to escape.
他向门口走去，企图逃跑。

They refused to negotiate, thus closing the door on any chance of a settlement.
他们拒绝谈判，因此堵死了解决闸题的途径。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 门，户; 出入口; 一家[户]; 通道
分布：门(89%)，门口(10%)，途径(1%)
→来自dhwer, 门，词源同forest, forum.
n.门;门口,出入口;门状物;家;通道Who lives next door to you?谁住在你的隔壁?
US [dɔ:r] noun countable
ESSENTIAL
■a flat object, often fixed at one edge, that is used to close the entrance of something such as a room or building, or the entrance itself 门
•the front door前门
•the back door后门
•a car door车门
•a sliding door拉门
•The door to his bedroom was locked.他卧室的门上了锁。
•We could hear someone knocking at/on the door.我们能听到有人在敲门。
•Could you open/close/shut the door, please?请把门打开／关上好吗？
•She asked me to answer the door (= go and open the door because someone had just knocked on it or rung the bell).她让我去开门。
be on the door
■to work at the entrance of a building, collecting tickets or preventing particular people from entering 守门，看门
■used to refer to a house or other building 房子，建筑物
•Sam only lives a few doors (away/up/down) from us.山姆就住在与我们相隔几户（远／以北／以南）的房子里。
•The people next door (to us) (= living in the house next to us) aren't very friendly.住在（我们）隔壁房子里的人不太友好。
out of doors
■outside in the open air 户外，室外
UK [dɔ:r] US [dɔ:r] noun countable
close/shut the door on sth
■to make it impossible for something to happen, especially a plan or a solution to a problem 使（尤指计划或解决方案）成为不可能
•There are fears that this latest move might have closed the door on a peaceful solution.人们担心这一最新动向或许已关闭了和平解决问题的大门。
UK [dɔ:r] US [dɔ:r] noun countable
open the door to sth
■to make something possible 使…可能／不可能
•These discussions may well open the door to a peaceful solution.此番讨论或许可以完全打开和平解决问题的大门。
UK [dɔ:r] US [dɔ:r] noun countable
shut / close the stable / barn door after the horse has bolted
■to be so late in taking action to prevent something bad happening that the bad event has already happened 亡羊补牢，为时已晚
door, gate
这组词都有“门”的意思，其区别是：
door: 指建筑物的大门或房间的门，一般有墙有顶，也指车辆等的门。
gate: 指校园、公园、工厂、城市或庭院等的大门，通常有墙无顶。
n. [建] 门；家，户；门口；通道
- home, exit, gateway, channel, route

entries.meaning: n.(集体)宿舍
entries.example:
She's not feeling well and is staying in the dorm.
她感觉不舒服，因此呆在宿舍里。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
She's not feeling well and is staying in the dorm.
她感觉不舒服，因此呆在宿舍里。

You will find our dorm a home from home.
你将会觉得在我们宿舍就像呆在家一样舒适。

details.text:
n. 宿舍

N-COUNT

entries.meaning:
n.集体宿舍
n.【美】学生宿舍楼
entries.example:
He hangs out in the school dormitory.
他留在学校的宿舍里。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
He hangs out in the school dormitory.
他留在学校的宿舍里。

Every girl must sign in when she comes back to the dormitory.
每个女生回到宿舍的时候都必须签到。

He soon gets accustomed to dormitory life and make two or three friend.
他不久就逐渐习惯了宿舍的生活并交了两三个朋友。

Every dormitory houses 200 students.
每一栋宿舍能容纳200个学生。

There is a garden in front of the dormitory.
宿舍前面是花园。

Over there stands the dormitory for you to live in.
那边就是给你们住的宿舍。

entries.meaning:
n.剂量；一剂；一服
vt.给 ... 服药
entries.example:
Take one dose of this cough syrup three times a day.
每天服三次这种止咳糖浆，每次服一剂量。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Take one dose of this cough syrup three times a day.
每天服三次这种止咳糖浆，每次服一剂量。

The doctor prescribed an oral dose of medicine.
医生开了一剂口服药。

A dose of this medicine will put you right.
这药你只要服一剂，你的病就会好的。

Failing the exam was a hard dose to swallow.
考试不及格是一服难咽的苦药。

She dosed up the children with cough syrup.
她把止咳糖浆给孩子们吃了。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 剂量，药量; （药的）一服，一剂; （处罚等）一回，一次，一番; （酒中的）配料，增味剂
vi. 服药
vt. 给药; 给…服药; 把（药等）配分剂量; 在（酒）中加料
时态：dosed, dosing, doses
分布：剂量(80%)，一剂(15%)，一服(4%)，给 ... 服药(1%)
→来自词根don, 给予，词源同data, donate. 引申词义一剂。
n.剂量,一服,一剂v.(给...)服药A dose of poison made the noisy man's nose rosy.一剂毒药使得吵闹的男子的鼻子变成玫瑰色.
US [doʊs] noun countable
ADVANCED
■a measured amount of something such as medicine 一剂
•a high/low dose大／小剂量
•a dose of penicillin一剂盘尼西林
•The label says to take one dose three times a day.标签上写着每次一剂，每日三次。
•Twenty or thirty of these pills would be a lethal dose (= enough to kill you).二三十粒这样的药丸就会达到致命剂量。
■an amount or experience of something bad or unpleasant 一些（糟糕或不愉快的事）
•The government received a hefty dose of bad news this week.本周政府得到了许多坏消息。
•She's got a nasty dose of flu.她得了一场严重的流感。
■UK slang
■a case of gonorrhea (= a disease of the sexual organs) 性器官感染淋病的个案
UK [dəʊs] US [doʊs] noun countable
in small doses
■for short periods of time 短时间，一会儿，片刻
•I can only stand opera in small doses.歌剧我只能欣赏一小会儿。
UK [dəʊs] US [doʊs] noun countable
like a dose of salts UK informal
■very quickly 迅速，快捷
•The medicine went through me like a dose of salts.这种药物很快就从我体内排出了。
UK [dəʊs] US [doʊs] verb transitive
■to give someone a measured amount of medicine 给（某人）开药；给（某人）用药
•informal He dosed him self (up)with valium to calm his nerves.他服了镇静药来缓解神经紧张。
n. [药] [核] 剂量；一剂，一服
- dosage, potion
vi. 服药
- take medicine
vt. 给药；给…服药
- physic

entries.meaning:
adj.双重的；成双的；两倍的
v.翻一番；使 ... 加倍
n.两倍；双份
entries.example:
The date had a double significance.
那个日子有双重意义。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
The date had a double significance.
那个日子有双重意义。

This machine serves a double purpose.
这部机器有双重用途。

The egg has a double yolk.
这只蛋双黄。

He was so fat that he had a double chin.
他胖得有双下巴了。

You can't park on a double yellow line.
有双黄线处不准停车。

I'll give you double pay for working overtime.
你加班我付你双倍工钱。

Shard joy is a double joy and shard sorrow is half a sorrow.
分享快乐会变成双倍的快乐,分享悲伤会减半。

I think we can double our profits in one month.
我认为我们可以在一个月内把利润翻一番。

The modern equipment enables them to double their production.
现代化的设备使他们能把产量翻倍。

If you should be off guard,you would double the loss.
如果你粗心大意，你一定会加倍损失。

If you double five， you make ten.
五加倍就是十。

The measures will enable us to double our output of bicycles.
这些措施能使我们的自行车产量加倍。

If you buy a new bicycle, it will cost more than double.
如果你买新的自行车，价格要贵一倍多。

I ordered the coffee in double before you come.
你来之前我点了双份咖啡。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
adj. 双的; 两倍的; 两面派的; 双人用的
vt. 使加倍; 把…对折; 重复
vi. 加倍，加倍努力; 快步走
adv. 两倍地; 双重地
n. 两倍; 双精度型
时态：doubled, doubling, doubles
分布：两倍(37%)，双重的(22%)，两倍的(15%)，双份(14%)，翻一番(8%)，成双的(3%)，使 ... 加倍(1%)
→来自拉丁语duplus, 双倍，du-, 二，词源同two, -pl, 倍，词源同ply.
翻倍[du,dub,doub=two,表示"二,双"]
a.两倍的;双重的ad.两倍地n.两部v.加倍I debated that the debtor was doubtless in double troubles.我争论说债务人很可能处在双重困境中.
【记】double-cross（v 背弃先前的协议；叛变联盟、朋友、伙伴）
adjective
ESSENTIAL
■twice the size, amount, price, etc., or consisting of two similar things together 两倍的；成双的；双份的
•I ordered a double espresso (= two standard amounts in one cup).我点了一杯双份的浓缩咖啡。
•Go through the double doors and turn left.穿过那道对开门，然后向左转。
•The word 'cool' has a double 'o' in the middle.单词 cool 的中间有两个字母 o。
•Everything he says has a double meaning (= has two possible meanings).他说的每句话都有双重含义。
•This painkiller is double strength (= has twice the normal amount of medicine).这种止痛药具有双倍功效。
•UK Sabiha's telephone number is double three, one, five, double seven (= 331577).萨比哈的电话号码是331577。
■A double flower or plant is a flower with more than the usual number of petals 重瓣花（其花瓣数量多于一般花的花瓣数量）
•a double primrose重瓣樱草花
['dʌb.l] noun
PERSON 人
countable usually singular
■a person who looks exactly the same as someone else 一模一样的人；极相像的人
•Hey, Tony, I met someone at a party last week who was your double.嘿，托尼，上周我在一次派对上遇到一个长得和你一模一样的人。
['dʌb.l] noun
TWO PLAYERS 双打
doubles uncountable
■a game of tennis or a similar sport between two teams of two people （网球等运动中的）双打
•men's/women's/mixed doubles男子／女子／混合双打
•Who won the men's doubles at Wimbledon this year?谁在今年温布顿网球赛中获得了男子双打冠军？
Compare singles
['dʌb.l] noun
BASEBALL 棒球
countable US
■in baseball, a hit that allows the batter (= person who hits the ball) to reach second base （棒球）二垒安打，指在防守队伍没有失误的情形下，一次就跑上二垒。
['dʌb.l] noun
at/on the double old-fashioned informal
■very quickly and without any delay 迅速，马上，立即
['dʌb.l] verb intransitive or transitive
IMPROVER
■to become twice as much or as many, or to make something twice as much or many 加一倍，翻一番
•The government aims to double the number of students in higher education within 25 years.政府计划在25年内使高校在校生人数增加一倍。
•Company profits have doubled since the introduction of new technology.自从引进新技术后，公司的利润增加了一倍。
['dʌb.l] verb intransitive or transitive
Phrasal Verbs double (up) as sth
■to be also used as something else 也可用作，还能当作
•The kitchen table doubles as my desk when I'm writing.我写东西时这个餐桌还可以当书桌用。
•Our spare bedroom doubles up as a study for Dan when he's working at home.丹在家工作时我们的备用睡房可以给他当工作间用。
['dʌb.l] verb intransitive or transitive
Phrasal Verbs double back
■to turn and go back in the direction you have come from 走回头路，原路返回
•We realized we had taken the wrong road and had to double back.我们发现走错了路，于是不得不原路返回。
['dʌb.l] verb intransitive or transitive
Phrasal Verbs double (sb) up/over
■If you double up/over, or if something doubles you up/over, you suddenly bend forwards and down, usually because of pain or laughter （通常指由于痛苦或大笑而）弯腰，前仰后合
•Most of the crowd doubled up with laughter at every joke.人群中的大多数人每听完一个笑话都会笑得前仰后合。
•She was doubled up/over with the pain in her stomach.她肚子痛得直不起腰来。
['dʌb.l] verb intransitive or transitive
Phrasal Verbs double up
■to share something, especially a room, with someone else 与他人共用（尤指房间）
•Terry will have to double up with Bill in the front bedroom.特里只好与比尔一起睡在前面的睡房里了。
['dʌb.l] noun predeterminer
ADVANCED
■something that is twice the amount, size, strength, etc. of something else 两倍（的），双倍（的）
•I paid double (= twice as much) for those trousers before the sale.减价前我买这条裤子花了两倍的价钱。
•Electrical goods are almost double the price they were a few years ago.与几年前相比，电器商品的价格几乎贵了一倍。
•"Would you like another whiskey?" "Yes. Make it a double (= two standard amounts in one glass)."“你想再来一杯威士卡吗?”“好的，来个双倍份量的。”
['dʌb.l] noun predeterminer
double or quits UK (US double or nothing)
■(in games where money is risked) an agreement that the player who owes money will owe twice as much if they lose, but will owe nothing if they win （在赌钱游戏中）赢了旧债一笔勾销，否则欠债要增加一倍
['dʌb.l] adverb
■in two parts or layers 双份地；双层地
•Fold the blanket double (= so that it is in two layers) and then you won't be cold.把毯子叠成两层，这样你就不会冷了。
•They were bent double (= Their heads and shoulders were bent far forward and down) from decades of labour in the fields.由于长年在田里劳作，他们的腰都给累弯了。
see double US
■to have a problem with your eyes so that you see two of everything, usually because you are drunk or ill （通常指因醉酒或疾病导致视力）出现重影
•I started seeing double, then I fainted.我的眼前开始出现重影，然后就晕了过去。
adj. 双重的；两倍的
- dual, two-fold
vi. 加倍，加倍努力；快步走
- redouble
vt. 使加倍
- duplicate
adv. 双重地；两倍地；弓身地
- twifold, twofold

entries.meaning:
n.怀疑；疑惑；悬而未定
vt.怀疑；不信任
vi.不确定
entries.example:
There is no doubt that we will be successful.
毫无疑问我们会成功的。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
There is no doubt that we will be successful.
毫无疑问我们会成功的。

Although a very religious man, he is still troubled by occasional doubts.
他虽然笃信宗教，但有时仍感到迷惘。

The outcome of this discussion is still in doubt.
这次讨论的结果还未定。

She was very angry with you, because you seemed to doubt what she had said.
她对你很生气,因为你似乎不相信她说的话,因为你似乎不相信她说的。

She said that I was getting into the habit of doubting.
她说我渐渐地好像对什么都不确定。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 怀疑，疑虑; 未确定
vt. 怀疑，疑惑
vi. 不确定，不能肯定或怀疑
时态：doubted, doubting, doubts
分布：怀疑(87%)，疑惑(6%)，不确定(4%)，不信任(2%)，悬而未定(1%)
→来自拉丁语dubius, 二，词源同dubious. 引申词义两面摇摆，怀疑。
怀疑(doubt二→二种状态→怀疑)[du,dub,doub=two,表示"二,双"]
n./v.怀疑,疑虑There is no doubt about his innocence.他完全是无辜的.
noun countable or uncountable
ESSENTIAL
■(a feeling of) not being certain about something, especially about how good or true it is （尤指对好坏、真实性的）怀疑，疑虑，疑问
•I'm having doubts about his ability to do the job.我对他是否能胜任此项工作还有一些疑问。
•If there's any doubt about the rocket's engines, we ought to cancel the launch.如果对火箭引擎还存有任何疑虑，我们都应该取消此次发射。
•The prosecution has to establish his guilt UK beyond (reasonable) doubt] US beyond a (reasonable) doubt.此次起诉必须证明他所犯的罪行证据确凿。
•This latest scandal has raised doubts about his suitability for the post.最近的这件丑闻让人们对他是否称职表示怀疑。
•[+ (that)] I never had any doubt (that) you would win.我从未怀疑你会获胜。
•He's the most attractive man in the building, no doubt about that/it.毫无疑问他是大楼里最有吸引力的男人。
no doubt
IMPROVER
■used to emphasize that what you are saying is true or likely to happen 毫无疑问，毋庸置疑，肯定
•We will, no doubt, discuss these issues again at the next meeting.毫无疑问，我们在下次会议上还要讨论这些问题。
•No doubt you'll want to unpack and have a rest before dinner.你肯定想在吃晚饭前先把行李收拾出来且休息一下。
cast doubt on sth
■to make something seem uncertain 对…怀有疑虑，对…表示怀疑
•Witnesses have cast doubt on the suspect's innocence.证人们对疑犯是否清白表示怀疑。
in doubt
■If the future or success of someone or something is in doubt, it is unlikely to continue or to be successful 前途未卜，前途未定；不确定
•The future of the stadium is in doubt because of a lack of money.由于缺少资金，该体育馆能否建成还不确定。
without (a) doubt
■used to emphasize your opinion 毫无疑问
•She is without (a) doubt the best student I have ever taught.毫无疑问她是我教过最优秀的学生。
⇒ See also undoubtedly
[daʊt] verb transitive
IMPROVER
■to not feel certain or confident about something or to think that something is not probable 怀疑；不确定，不肯定
•I doubt whether/if I can finish the work on time.我怀疑自己能否按时完成这项工作。
•[+ that] They had begun to doubt that it could be completed in time.他们开始怀疑能否及时完工。
•He may come back tomorrow with the money, but I very much doubt it.也许明天他会把钱带回来，但我对此深表怀疑。
•I don't doubt his abilities.我并不怀疑他的能力。
doubt sb /doubt sb's word
■to not trust someone or believe what they say 不相信，不信任，怀疑（某人／某人的话）
•He's never lied to me before, so I have no reason to doubt his word.以前他从未对我说过谎，因此我没有理由怀疑他说的话。
doubt, suspect, distrust
这组词都有“怀疑”的意思，其区别是：
doubt: 普通用词，多指因证据不足或仅凭证据还不能肯定而产生怀疑，多含否定意味。
suspect: 指猜疑、疑心，肯定意味较多。
distrust: 指疑惑、猜疑，不信任。
doubt, supicion, distrust, uncertainty
这些名词均有“怀疑”之意。
doubt: 指对事物的真、假有怀疑。
supicion: 语气较强，指对某人做某事的目的、意图有怀疑，或认为某人做错事，但无确凿证据而产生怀疑。
distrust: 一般用词，泛指对某人某事不信任而感到怀疑。
uncertainty: 侧重指对某事或选择等需作决定时的迟疑不决。
n. [法] 怀疑；疑问；疑惑
- challenge, question, query, suspicion
v. [法] 怀疑；不信；恐怕；拿不准
- suspect of, be suspicious of

details.text:

分布：怀疑的(60%)，可疑的(32%)，不确定的(8%)
可疑的,怀疑的(doubt+ful)[du,dub,doub=two,表示"二,双"]
adjective
ADVANCED
■If you are doubtful about something, you are uncertain about it 怀疑的，有疑虑的；不能确定的
•The teacher is doubtful about having parents working as classroom assistants.这位老师对由家长担任课堂助教一事拿不定主意。
ADVANCED
■If a situation is doubtful, it is unlikely to happen or to be successful 不大可能的
•It is doubtful whether/if they ever reached the summit before they died.他们死前不太可能到过山顶。
•It was doubtful that the money would ever be found again.再找到那些钱不太可能了。
uncertain, questionable, doubtful, ambigous
这组词都有“怀疑的，不确定的”的意思，其区别是：
uncertain: 多指因缺乏证据或了解而捉摸不定，也指因不能预料而不能作出选择。
questionable: 通常指怀疑某行为是否恰当，或指有根有据的怀疑。
doubtful: 指对某个问题持积极怀疑的，有疑问的态度，强调缺乏确信。
ambigous: 指因缺乏明确感或因为有各种不同的解释而值得怀疑。
adj. 可疑的；令人生疑的；疑心的；不能确定的

details.text:
n. 汇票; 草稿; 选派; （尤指房间、烟囱、炉子等供暖系统中的）（小股）气流
vt. 起草; 制定; 征募
vi. 拟稿; 绘样; 作草图
adj. 初步画出或（写出）的; （设计、草图、提纲或版本）正在起草中的，草拟的; 以草稿形式的; 草图的
时态：drafted, drafting, drafts
分布：汇票(32%)，起草(24%)，草稿(21%)，草图(10%)，征兵(7%)，选秀(5%)，酝酿中的(1%)
→来自draught拼写变体，并更广泛流行。
n.草稿,草案,草图v.起草,草拟The draft for aircraft is sent to the airline by airmail.订购航空器的汇票用航空邮件寄给了航空公司.
【参】draftsmanship（n 制图技术；制图术）
US [dræft] noun
PLAN 计划
ADVANCED countable
■a piece of text, a formal suggestion or a drawing in its original state, often containing the main ideas and intentions but not the developed form 草案；草稿；草图
•This is only a rough draft - the finished article will have pictures as well.这只是一个粗略的草稿——定稿后的文章中还会有一些图片。
•She asked me to check the (first) draft of her proposal.她请我检查一下她的（第一稿）提案草稿。
UK [drɑ:ft] US [dræft] noun
MILITARY 军事的
the draft only singular mainly US (UK conscription)
■the system of ordering people by law to join the armed forces 兵役制
•He avoided the draft because of a foot injury.他因脚伤而躲过了服兵役。
UK [drɑ:ft] US [dræft] noun
MONEY 钱
countable
■a written order for money to be paid by a bank, especially to another bank （尤指向银行支付的）汇票
•I arranged for some money to be sent from London to Madrid by banker's draft.我安排以银行汇票的方式把一些钱从伦敦寄到马德里。
UK [drɑ:ft] US [dræft] noun
COLD AIR 冷空气
countable US for
■draught (COLD AIR)
UK [drɑ:ft] US [dræft] verb UK
PLAN 计划
■to write down a document for the first time, including the main points but not all the details 第一次起草的文件、计划等（包含主要观点但内容并不详实）
•Draft a proposal for the project and we can discuss it at the meeting.先起草一个企划案草案，我们可以在会上就此讨论。
UK [drɑ:ft] US [dræft] verb UK
MILITARY 军事的
transitive usually passive mainly US (UK conscript)
■to order people by law to join the armed forces 兵役制
•He was drafted (into the army) at eighteen.他18岁时应征参军（入伍）。
UK [drɑ:ft] US [dræft] verb UK
Phrasal Verbs [M] draft sb in
■to bring someone somewhere to do a particular job 征召（某人），调集某人（从事某项工作）
•Every Christmas thousands of people are drafted in to help with the post.每逢圣诞节，成千上万的人都被召集来帮助处理邮件。
UK [drɑ:ft] US [dræft] adjective [before noun]
■describes a plan, document etc. in its first form, including the main points but not all the details 第一次起草的档、计划等（包含主要观点但内容并不详实）
•a draft plan/bill/proposal计划／提案／建议草稿
sketch, draft, blueprint, diagram, outline, plot
这组词都有“绘制”的意思，其区别是：
sketch: 指用图、模型或语言描述来表示某一事物的整体情况。
draft: 用作动词时指按准确比例设计或打样；作名词时专指精确的草图或草案。
blueprint: 主要指绘制蓝图或制定纲领或规划。这个词引申用来指详细而具体的行动计划。
diagram: 侧重指用图形、图表等来说明。
outline: 主要给出事物要点或轮廓，强调简化了的整体。
plot: 可与draft和diagram换用，但侧重于表示具体的点、面、部分或目标，从而使相互关系以及和整体的关系得以明确。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
vt. 拖拽; 吃力地往前拉; 拖地而行
vi. 沿地面拖动; 落后; 缓慢前进; 打捞
n. 拖，拉; 累赘; 阻力
时态：dragged, dragging, drags
分布：拖(73%)，阻力(14%)，拉(11%)，累赘(1%)，扯进(1%)
→来自dhragh, 拉，词源同draw, tractor.
v.拖,拖曳The ragged man drags a waggon of rag fragments.那个衣衫褴褛的人拉着一货车破布碎片.
verb (-gg-)
PULL 拉
IMPROVER transitive
■to move something by pulling it along a surface, usually the ground 拖，拉，拽，牵引
•Pick the chair up instead of dragging it behind you!把椅子拿起来，不要在地上拖！
•She dragged the canoe down to the water.她把独木舟拉到水边。
ADVANCED transitive + adverb or preposition
■to make someone go somewhere they do not want to go 硬拖，硬拉，硬拽
•She had to drag her child away from the toy shop.她不得不把孩子从玩具店硬拉出来。
•I really had to drag myself out of bed this morning.今天早上我真是硬撑着从床上爬了起来。
ADVANCED transitive
■to move something on a computer screen using a mouse (DEVICE) （用滑鼠）拖动
transitive
■If you drag a subject into a conversation, etc., you begin to talk about it even if it is not connected with what you are talking about 插入（话题），把…扯进（谈话中）
•She's always dragging sex into the conversation.她总把性扯到谈话中来。

[dræg] verb (-gg-)
BORING 单调的
intransitive
■If something such as a film or performance drags, it seems to go slowly because it is boring （电影或表演等）枯燥；拖拖拉拉
•The first half of the film was interesting but the second half dragged (on).电影的上半部很有趣，但下半部却拖拖拉拉。
[dræg] verb (-gg-)
drag your heels/feet
■to do something slowly because you do not want to do it 拖拖拉拉地做，磨磨蹭蹭地干
•I suspect the government is dragging its heels over this issue.我怀疑政府在这个问题上拖延时间。
[dræg] verb (-gg-)
drag sb's name through the mire / mud
■to damage someone's reputation by saying extremely insulting things about them 对某人泼脏水，败坏某人的名声
[dræg] verb (-gg-)
