details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
adj. 坦白的，直率的; 清楚表明的; 明显的
n. 弗兰克; 免费邮寄权; 免费邮戳或签名; 免费邮寄的信件
vt. 免费寄（邮件）; 盖免费邮寄公章; 盖邮戳; 便于使（人）自由地来往
时态：franked, franking, franks
分布：坦白的(38%)，直率的(33%)，免费邮寄(16%)，真诚的(10%)，使自由出入(3%)
→来自Frank, 法兰克人，部落名。在公元五世纪，整个西欧仍处在一种野蛮的部落时代，整个社会被分成自由人，俘虏，和奴隶三个等级，而Frank人做为战胜级，享受唯一的自由权。后部落名通用化，赋予诸多美好的词义，如自由的，高贵的，美丽的，优雅的，大方的，真诚的等。后主要用于坦率的，其它词义逐渐废弃。参照电影《庞贝末日》。Frank 法兰克人
a.坦白的,直率的The frank man put the first-rank blank blanket into the tan tank.直率的男子将一流空白毛毯放进黝黑的大容器
【参】blank（adj 空白的；没有表情的n 空白）都源于：ank表示“白”
adjective
■honest, sincere and telling the truth, even when this might be awkward or make other people uncomfortable 坦率的，坦诚的；直言不讳的
•a full and frank discussion全面而坦诚的讨论
•There followed a frank exchange of views.接下来大家坦诚地交换了意见。
•The magazine, which gives frank advice about sex and romance, is aimed at the teenage market.这本杂志面向青少年市场，对性和恋爱问题作出坦率的忠告。
•To be perfectly frank with you, I don't think she's the woman for the job.十分坦诚地告诉你，我认为她不适合做那份工作。
[fræŋk] verb transitive
■to print a mark on a stamp so that the stamp cannot be used again, or to print a mark on an envelope to show that the cost of sending it has been paid 在（邮票）上盖戳；在（信封）上盖戳表示邮资已付
open, frank, sincere, blunt, honest, plain, straightforward
这组词都有“坦率，诚实”的意思，其区别是：
open: 指不隐瞒自己的秘密，愿意向他人表露自己或公开暴露自己的缺点。
frank: 强调毫无保留地畅所欲言，不受任何约束。
sincere: 侧重指一个人出自内心地对某人某事表示一种诚意。
blunt: 指讲话坦白直率、不客气，但隐含不得体、不顾及他人感情等意味。
honest: 指遵守正直等道德准则。
plain: 指直言不讳，毫不做作或故弄玄虚。
straightforward: 多用于答复、叙述等场合。指直截了当，不回避，或故弄玄虚。
adj. 坦白的，直率的；老实的
- explicit, naked, confessed

entries.meaning: adv.自由地；免费地；直率地；大量地
entries.example:
The Woodstock generation attempted to swing freely.
伍德斯托克一代试图自由地赶时髦。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
The Woodstock generation attempted to swing freely.
伍德斯托克一代试图自由地赶时髦。

Love is freely given, not doled out on demand.
爱是自由地给予，爱不是在需要的时候施舍。

I freely admit the former existence of many islands, now buried beneath the sea, which may have served as haltingplaces for plants and for many animals during their migration.
我直率地承认，从前曾存在过许多岛屿可作为植物和许多动物迁移中歇足之地，现在都已埋在海下了。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
adv. 自由地，随意地，免费地; 直率地; 免费地; 慷慨地
分布：自由地(34%)，大量地(22%)，免费地(22%)，直率地(22%)
adverb
NOT LIMITED 不受限制地
ADVANCED
■without being controlled or limited 自由地；不受控制地；不受限制地
•For the first time in months she could move freely.数月以来她第一次可以自由走动。
•Exotic foods are freely available in supermarkets.超市里随时可以买到来自外国的食品。
•She freely (= willingly) admits that she's not as fast a runner as she used to be.她爽快地承认不如以前跑得快了。
•We encourage the victims to talk freely (= talk a lot and honestly) about their experiences.我们鼓励受害者坦率讲出他们的经历。
['fri:.li] adverb
ABLE TO MOVE EASILY 可轻易移动
■in a way which is not fixed or joined to anything, so able to move easily 可轻易移动地
•Remember to apply plenty of oil so that the wheel can rotate freely.记住上足油，这样轮子才转得顺。
adv. 自由地；免费地；大量地；慷慨地；直率地
- largely, importantly, big, heavy

entries.meaning:
v.冻结；冷冻；僵硬；凝固
n.严寒；冻结
entries.example:
Water freezes at the temperature of 0 degrees Celsius.
水在摄氏零度结冰。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Water freezes at the temperature of 0 degrees Celsius.
水在摄氏零度结冰。

We ate some of the fruits and froze the rest.
我们吃了一些水果，把剩下的冷藏起来。

They freeze this theory to death.
他们把这个理论僵化了。

The quality of the imagination is to flow and not to freeze.
想象的特点是流动,而不是凝固。

The freeze caused many problems in the small town.
严寒冰冻给这座小镇带来许多麻烦。

The government has introduced a wage freeze.
政府已宣布要冻结工资。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
vt. 使结冰，使冻僵; 冷藏; 吓呆; 冻结（存款，工资等）
vi. 凝固，结冰; 冻伤，冻死
n. 冻结; 严寒时期
时态：froze, frozen, freezing, freezes
分布：冻结(72%)，冷冻(22%)，凝固(3%)，严寒(2%)，僵硬(1%)
→来自preus, 冷，冰冻，发烧，词源同frost, prurient. 这种看似矛盾的词义比较calm，或感冒发烧，长冻疮等的病症。
v.使结冰,使凝固In the freezing breeze, the breeder greedily squeezed oil from the seeds.在冰冷的微风中,饲养员贪婪地从种子中榨油.
verb (froze, frozen)
COLD 冷
IMPROVER intransitive or transitive
■If you freeze something, you lower its temperature below 0°C, causing it to become cold and often hard, and if something freezes, its temperature goes below 0°C （使）冻结，（使）结冰
•Water freezes to ice at a temperature of 0°C.水在摄氏零度结冰。
•The ground had frozen hard/solid.地面已经冻得硬邦邦的了。
•When the lake freezes (over) (= turns into ice on the surface) , we can go skating on it.湖面结冰后，我们可以在上面滑冰。
•Our pipes froze (up) (= the water in them turned to ice) several times last winter.去年冬天我们的水管冻了好几次。
•The weather forecast says that it is going to freeze tonight (= that the temperature will be at or below 0°C).天气预报说今晚温度会至冰点或更低。
•Without a sleeping bag, you would freeze to death (= become so cold that you die) out there on the mountainside.在山坡那里，没有睡袋你会被冻死。
IMPROVER intransitive or transitive
■to preserve food by storing it at a very low temperature so that it becomes hard 冷冻保存（食物）
•I'll freeze any food that's left over.我会把剩下的食物都冷冻起来。
•Most soups freeze (= can be preserved by being stored at a very low temperature) well.大多数汤都可以冷冻保存。
[fri:z] verb (froze, frozen)
STOP WORKING 停止工作
intransitive US (also freeze up)
■If an engine or lock freezes, it stops working because its parts have become stuck and can no longer move （引擎或锁）卡住，堵塞
•My old bicycle was so rusty that the gears had frozen.我的旧自行车锈得太厉害，齿轮都卡住不动了。
•If the lock has frozen up, try lubricating it with oil.如果锁卡住了，上点油润滑一下试试。
[fri:z] verb (froze, frozen)
STOP MOVING 停止移动
intransitive
■If a person or animal that is moving freezes, it stops suddenly and becomes completely still, especially because of fear （尤指出于恐惧）僵住，呆住
•She saw someone outside the window and froze.她看见窗外有人，一下就呆住了。
•"Freeze (= Don't move) or I'll shoot", screamed the gunman.“不许动，否则我就开枪了！”那个持枪者大喊道。
[fri:z] verb (froze, frozen)
MONEY/PROPERTY 资金／财产
transitive
■To freeze something such as pay or prices is to fix them at a particular level and not allow any increases 使（工资、物价等）固定不变，阻止…增长
•The Government has frozen pensions until the end of next year.政府已决定在明年年底之前维持养老金水准不变。
transitive
■to officially and legally prevent money or property from being used or moved 冻结（资金或财产）
•When it was obvious the company was going bankrupt, the government ordered all their assets to be frozen.当该公司很明显要破产倒闭时，政府下令冻结其全部资产。
[fri:z] verb (froze, frozen)
be cold enough to freeze the balls off a brass monkey humorous
■to be very cold 冷得要命
[fri:z] verb (froze, frozen)
Phrasal Verbs [M] freeze sb out
■to make someone feel that they are not part of a group by being unfriendly towards them, or to stop someone from being included in an arrangement or activity 排挤，排斥（某人）
•I felt I was being frozen out of/from the discussions.我感觉他们在排挤我，不让我参加讨论。
•He believed that organizations like theirs were being frozen out.他认为他们那一类的组织被排除在外了。
[fri:z] noun
COLD WEATHER 寒冷天气
only singular
■a period of extremely cold weather 严寒期，冰冻期
[fri:z] noun
STOP 停止
countable
■a temporary stopping of something （暂时的）冻结，停滞
•The Government has imposed a wage freeze/a freeze on wage increases.政府暂时冻结了工资增长。
vi. [物] 冻结；冷冻；僵硬
- rigidize
n. [物] 冻结；凝固
- solidification, coagulation

entries.meaning:
n.（货运）运费；货运；货物
vt.装货于；运送
entries.example:
At an auction, the buyer pays the freight.
在拍卖会上，买家支付运费。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
At an auction, the buyer pays the freight.
在拍卖会上，买家支付运费。

The freight must be added to the cost of the goods.
运费必须打入货的成本。

We can send it by air/sea freight.
我们可以空运[海运]。

Eight thousand tons of freight were being landed each day.
每天卸货8000吨上岸。

They freighted the boat with bananas.
他们把香蕉装上船。

You can freight your belongings by air or sea.
你可把东西经空运或海运运去。

We freight goods to all parts of America.
我们将货物发往全美各地。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 货运，货物; 运费; 船运货物; 货运列车
vt. 运输; 装货于
时态：freighted, freighting, freights
分布：货运(59%)，货物(34%)，运送(6%)，装货于(1%)
→来自Proto-Germanic*fra-aigan, *fra, 整个的，*aigan, 拥有，所有，词源同own.即所有物，装上船的，发货的。其原义仅指水运或船运，后词义通用化。
n.货物,货运,运费My neighbor knows the height and weight of the highjacked freight.我邻居知道被劫持货船的高度和重量.
noun uncountable
■goods, but not passengers, that are carried from one place to another, by ship, aircraft, train or truck, or the system of transporting these goods 货物；货运
•The ship carries both freight and passengers.这艘船既载货又载客。
•a freight company货运公司
•Will the goods be sent by air or sea freight?这些货物要空运还是海运？
•freight trains货运列车
•US The escaped prisoner made his getaway in a freight car/wagon on a train.逃犯躲在火车的载货车厢里逃脱了。
■the money paid for transporting goods 运费
[freɪt] verb transitive
■to send goods by air, sea or train 运送（货物）
•Grapes from this region are freighted all over the world.这个地区生产的葡萄被运到世界各地。
[freɪt] adverb
■transported as part of a large group of things, by ship, aircraft, train or truck 货物；货运
•It would be much cheaper to send the goods freight.把货物集中发运会便宜得多。
commodity, merchandise, ware, freight, goods
这组词都有“商品，货物”的意思，其区别是：
commodity: 作“商品”解时系经济学名词，也可指日用品。
merchandise: 正式用词，指商业上销售或商家拥有货物的总称。
ware: 指上市待卖的商品或货物。多用复数形式。
freight: 指“货物”时，可与goods互换，此系美国英语。在英国，freight志指船装货物。
goods: 一般生活或商业用词，指销售或购入的商品。
vt. 运送；装货；使充满
- ship, transit, forward
n. 货运； [交] 运费； [水运] 船货
- charges, carriage

entries.meaning:
n.法国人；法语
adj.法国人的；法国的；法语的
vt.(从骨头)剔肉；切成细条
entries.example:
The French are renowned for their cooking.
法国人擅长烹饪。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
The French are renowned for their cooking.
法国人擅长烹饪。

He speaks not only English but also French.
他不但会说英语，而且还会说法语。

Some of us can speak English. Others/Some can speak French.
我们有些人会说英语，有些人会说法语。

I've only recently started learning French.
我是最近才开始学法语的。

This student is good at French.
这个学生法语好。

They assumed I was French from my surname.
他们从我的姓推测我是法国人。

Do you like French films?
你喜欢法国影片吗？

It 's one of the best French restaurants in Boston.
这是波士顿最好的法国餐馆之一。

The French paper was set by our form teacher.
法语试卷是我们的班主任出的。

He knows a few French words.
他知道一点法语词。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 法国人；法语
adj. 法国的；法语的；法国人的
分布：法语(60%)，法国人(20%)，法国的(13%)，法语的(4%)，法国人的(2%)，切成细条(1%)
→来自Frank, 法兰克人。french 口交
noun uncountable
ESSENTIAL
■the language that people speak in France, Belgium, parts of Canada and other countries 法语
the French
ESSENTIAL [plural]
■the people of France 法国人
[frentʃ] noun uncountable
Excuse/Pardon my French. old-fashioned humorous
■said when you are pretending to be sorry for saying a swear word 对不起，我讲了粗话
•That sod Wilkins, excuse my French, has taken my bloody parking space.该死的威尔金斯——不好意思讲了粗口——他妈的占了我的停车位。
[frentʃ] adjective
IMPROVER
■from, belonging to or relating to France 法国的；与法国有关的
•French food/culture/music法国食品／文化／音乐
[frentʃ] adjective
■relating to France or to the French language 法国的，法语的
•We spent our holidays in a small French town.我们在一个法国小镇里度假。
adj. 法国的；法语的；法国人的
- Gallo
n. 法语；法国人
- Francais

entries.meaning: n.频繁；频率
entries.example:
Accidents on that highway are happening with increasing frequency.
那条高速公路上车祸发生得越来越频繁。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Accidents on that highway are happening with increasing frequency.
那条高速公路上车祸发生得越来越频繁。

Accidents are happening with increasing frequency.
事故正在愈加频繁地发生。

He wrote to both with tolerable frequency.
他和他们通信，相当频繁。

He varied the transmission frequency.
他变换了无线电传送的频率。

He tuned his radio to the police frequency.
他把无线电调到警方的频率。

The pitch depends on the frequency.
音调的高低是由频率决定的。

We can often correlate age with frequency of illness.
年龄的大小往往与发病率有关。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 频繁性; [数][物]频率，次数; 频率分布
分布：频率(95%)，频繁(5%)
→来自frequent, 频繁的。用于语音学名词。
n.频率,周率This radio station broadcasts on three different frequencies.这家电台用三种不同的周率广播.
【反】rarity（n 稀有）
noun
HAPPENING 发生
countable or uncountable
■the number of times something happens within a particular period, or the fact of something happening often or a large number or times （事件发生的）频度，次数；频繁
•Complaints about the frequency of trains rose by 201% in the last year.去年对火车发车频率的投诉增长了201%。
•the increasing frequency of terrorist attacks越来越频繁的恐怖袭击
•It's not the duration of his absences from work so much as the frequency that worries me.与他的旷工时日相比，他旷工的频繁程度更让我担忧。
['fri:.kwənt.si] noun
LIGHT/SOUND/RADIO, ETC 光／声音／电波
uncountable specialized
■the number of times that a wave, especially a sound or radio wave, is produced within a particular period, especially one second （尤指声波或无线电波每秒振动的）频率
•the frequency of light光的频率
•low frequency radiation低频辐射
•The human ear cannot hear very high-frequency sounds.人耳听不到极高频率的声音。
countable specialized
■a particular number of radio waves produced in a second at which a radio signal is broadcast 频率（无线电信号的每秒电波数）
•Do you know what frequency the BBC World Service is on ?你知道英国广播公司的广播频率是多少吗？
n. [物] 频率；频繁
- periodicity

entries.meaning:
adj.频繁的；经常的
vt.常到；常去
entries.example:
My girlfriend writes frequent letters to me.
我的女朋友频繁地给我写信。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
My girlfriend writes frequent letters to me.
我的女朋友频繁地给我写信。

Traffic accidents are alarmingly frequent of late.
近来交通事故频繁得吓人。

He is a frequent visitor to our house.
他是我们家的常客。

He suffers from frequent bouts of depression.
他患多发性抑郁症。

His frequent hesitations annoyed the audience.
他三番五次欲言又止，听众已感到厌烦。

He used to frequent the town's bars and night-clubs.
他从前常去镇上的酒吧和夜总会。

The police visited all the bars that the suspect frequented.
警察调查了嫌疑犯时常出没的所有酒吧。

These woods are frequented by all kinds of birds.
这些树林里经常栖息着各种鸟类。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
adj. 频繁的，时常发生的，常见的; （脉搏等）急促的，快的
时态：frequented, frequenting, frequents
分布：频繁的(58%)，常去(21%)，常到(11%)，经常的(10%)
→来自拉丁语frequens, 反复的，拥挤的，硬塞的。可能来自ger, 围，转，包围，词源同cram, crowd, group.
a.时常发生的,频繁的Subsequently the eloquent man frequently asked the consequence of quenching in sequence.其后雄辩者频繁地询问顺序灭火的结果.
【反】visit rarely（很少拜访）；shun『avoid』有争议：shun侧重故意避开危险、真理、社交等＝avoid deliberately；avoid可指避开任何东西，人，事。它们的区别就在于deliberately，但是没有字典指出frequent是否有故意的含义。但是我会选avoid，有例句表明avoid可以用来避免一个地方。（仅供参考）
US [ˈfriː.kwənt] formal
■to be in or visit a particular place often 常去，常到（某处）
•a bar frequented by criminals犯罪分子经常光顾的酒吧
constant, continual, consist, frequent
constant: 恒久不变的
continual: 多次重复的，不间断的
consist: 由…组成
frequent: 日常的，频繁的
adj. 频繁的；时常发生的；惯常的
- confirmed, continual
vt. 常到，常去；时常出入于
- resort to

entries.meaning: adv.频繁地；经常地
entries.example:
Buses run frequently from the city to the airport.
公共汽车频繁地从城市驶往机场。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Buses run frequently from the city to the airport.
公共汽车频繁地从城市驶往机场。

The bicyclists must be hydrated frequently.
自行车运动员必须频繁地喝水。

His speech was frequently interrupted by stormy applause.
他的演说不时被暴风雨般的掌声打断。

He comes to visit me frequently.
他经常来看我。

Stores of grain are frequently attacked by pests.
储存的谷物经常受到害虫的破坏。

The area is flooded, as frequently happens during the typhoon.
这个地区淹了水，这是台风时经常发生的。

My judgement was frequently faulty, but my loyalty to the nation could not be questioned.
我的判断经常出错，但是我对祖国的忠诚是无可置疑的。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
adv. 频繁地，屡次地; 往往; 动; 动辄
分布：频繁地(60%)，经常地(40%)
adverb
ESSENTIAL
■often 频繁地，经常地
•frequently asked questions经常问到的问题
•I see him quite frequently.我和他见面非常频繁。
•The buses run less frequently on Sundays.周日公车班次间隔时间较长。
regularly, often, usually, repeatedly, always, frequently
这些副词均表示频度。
regularly: 用于修饰经常而有规律性的动作。
often: 经常，语气弱于always,侧重动作发生的次数具有经常性，具体时间意味不强。
usually: 通常，通例地，指习惯性动作，频度仅次于always，较often大，偶尔有间隔。
repeatedly: 屡次，强调次数多，但反复的频率不一定均匀。
always: 总是，永远。语气最强，指在一切时候，没有例外。
frequently: 时常，经常，与often同义，可通用，但较正式，强调次数频繁。
adv. 频繁地，经常地；时常，屡次
- continually, regular

entries.meaning:
adj.新鲜的；清新的；新近的；无经验的
adv.最近地
entries.example:
Some tribes migrate with their cattle in search of fresh grass.
有些部落为了寻找新鲜的牧草而带着他们的牲畜迁移。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Some tribes migrate with their cattle in search of fresh grass.
有些部落为了寻找新鲜的牧草而带着他们的牲畜迁移。

Open the window and let in some fresh air.
打开窗户，让新鲜的空气进来。

When fresh supplies come into the market, we can revert to your enquiry.
等新货上市时，我们才能回头考虑你们的询盘。

I feel really fresh after my holiday.
我度假之後真觉得又精神饱满了。

There was no sense in courting fate with a new, able, and psychologically fresh group.
把命运同一批能干的、但心理上无经验的新人拴在一起是没有什么意思的。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
adj. 新鲜的; 淡水的; 新的; 无经验的
adv. 刚; 最新的
n. 开始; 新生; 泛滥; 淡水流
级别：fresher, freshest
分布：新鲜的(71%)，清新的(12%)，无经验的(10%)，新近的(4%)，最近地(3%)
→来自preisk, 新鲜的，有活力的，进一步来自preu, 蹦，跳，词源同frog, frolic. 并由此引申诸多词义。
a.新鲜的,无经验的The fresh flesh on the mesh refreshed the dog.网格上的新鲜肉使狗恢复了体力.
adjective
NEW 新的
ESSENTIAL [before noun]
■new; different or another 新的；不同的；另外的
•The original orders were cancelled and I was given fresh instructions.原来的命令撤销了，我又接到了新的指令。
•Fresh evidence has emerged that casts doubts on the men's conviction.出现了新的证据，对这些人的定罪出现了疑点。
•We need to take a fresh look at the problem.我们需要重新看待该问题。
•Your coffee is cold - let me make you a fresh cup.你的咖啡凉了——我给你冲一杯新的吧。
•There has been fresh fighting between police and demonstrators.警方和示威者又发生了冲突。
•They decided to move abroad and make a fresh start.他们决定移民海外，从头开始。
ESSENTIAL [before noun] approving
■new and therefore interesting or exciting 新颖有趣的
•His book offers some fresh insights into the events leading up to the war.他的书就导致那场战争的事件提出了一些新颖的见解。
•We have tried to come up with a fresh new approach.我们试图找到一种新颖的方法。
[freʃ] adjective
RECENT 最近的
ADVANCED
■recently made, done, arrived, etc., and especially not yet changed by time 新近的；新做的；新到的
•There was a fresh fall of snow during the night.晚上刚下了一场雪。
•There's nothing better than fresh bread, straight from the oven.再也没有甚么比刚出炉的新鲜面包更好的了。
•The house, with its fresh coat of paint, looked lovely in the sunshine.这所房子刚刷过漆，在阳光下显得很漂亮。
•She's fresh out of/from university and very bright.她刚刚大学毕业，人很聪明。
•The events of last year are still fresh in people's minds (= people can remember them easily).人们对去年发生的一些事仍记忆犹新。
be fresh out mainly US
■If you are fresh out of something, you have just finished or sold all of it, so that there is no more left. 刚用完；刚卖光
[freʃ] adjective
NATURAL 自然的
ADVANCED
■(of food or flowers) in a natural condition rather than artificially preserved by a process such as freezing （食物或花）新鲜的，非冷冻的
•fresh fruit and vegetables新鲜水果和蔬菜
•fresh fish/meat鲜鱼／肉
•fresh coffee新煮的咖啡
[freʃ] adjective
AIR 空气
■(of air) clean and cool; found outside rather than in a room （空气）清新的，新鲜的
•I opened the window to let some fresh air in.我打开窗子放进一些新鲜空气。
•fresh mountain air山里的新鲜空气
•I'm just going out for a breath of fresh air.我正要出去呼吸新鲜空气。
■describes weather that is cool and sometimes windy （天气）凉爽的，清凉的
•It was a lovely fresh spring morning.这是一个凉爽宜人的春天的早晨。
•There's quite a fresh breeze today.今天风不小，有些凉意。
[freʃ] adjective
CLEAN 清洁的
■clean and pleasant 洁净的；清爽宜人的
•I felt wonderfully clean and fresh after my shower.洗完澡后我感到非常清爽舒适。
•I use a mouthwash to keep my breath fresh.我用漱口水保持口气清新。
•This wine has a light, fresh taste.这种葡萄酒味道清淡爽口。
[freʃ] adjective
NOT TIRED 不累的
[after verb]
■energetic and enthusiastic; not tired 精力充沛的；精神饱满的
•I'll deal with this problem in the morning when I'm fresh.我会在上午精力充沛的时候处理这一问题。
•Try and get some sleep on the plane, then you'll arrive feeling fresh.尽量在飞机上睡一会儿，到达时就会有精神。
[freʃ] adjective
SKIN 皮肤
■(of a face) natural, healthy and young looking （面部）容光焕发的，充满青春活力的
•She has a lovely fresh (= clear and smooth) complexion.她气色很好，皮肤光洁。
[freʃ] adjective
NOT SALTY 不咸的
[before noun]
■(of water) not salty （水）淡的，无盐的
•Trout are fresh water fish (= live in water that is not salty).鳟鱼是淡水鱼。
•These plants are found in fresh water lakes and rivers (= those containing water that is not salty).这些植物生长在淡水河湖里。
[freʃ] adjective
TOO CONFIDENT 过于自信的 informal
■being too confident and showing no respect, or showing by your actions or words that you want to have sex with someone 自以为是的，放肆无礼的；（对异性）轻佻放肆的
•Don't you get fresh with me, young woman!别勾引我，姑娘！
•He started getting fresh (= behaving in a sexual way) in the cinema, so she slapped his face.在戏院里他就对她动手动脚，所以她打了他一耳光。
[freʃ] adjective
be as fresh as a daisy
■to be full of energy and enthusiasm 精神饱满
•After a good night's sleep I'll be as fresh as a daisy.好好睡上一觉后我就会精神焕发。
new, fresh, original, innovative, novel
这组词都有“新的”的意思，其区别是：
new: 普通用词，与old相对，指最近的或创新的。
fresh: 指新鲜的、新做的，侧重创新。
original: 强调独创性。
innovative: 强调富有创新和革新精神。
novel: 侧重新事物的新奇和独特。
adj. 新鲜的；清新的； [水文] 淡水的；无经验的
- new, raw
n. 开始；新生；泛滥
- beginning, threshold, opening, conception, start
adv. 刚刚，才；最新地
- hardly, just

entries.meaning: n.摩擦；摩擦力；分歧
entries.example:
Constant friction wore out the heels of my shoes.
不断的摩擦磨损了我的鞋跟。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Constant friction wore out the heels of my shoes.
不断的摩擦磨损了我的鞋跟。

Matches are lighted by friction.
火柴由摩擦而生火。

Friction lowers the efficiency of a machine.
摩擦减低机器的效率。

Friction causes a rolling ball to stop finally.
摩擦力使滚动的球最终停了下来。

Without friction, the brake would not work.
如果没有摩擦力,制动器就不能制动。

I oiled the machine to reduce friction.
我把机器上油,以减少摩擦力。

My daughter and son always have frictions.
我女儿和儿子总发生矛盾。

There is some friction among the family members.
家庭成员间有些摩擦。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 摩擦; 冲突，不和; 摩擦力
分布：摩擦(82%)，摩擦力(17%)，分歧(1%)
→来自bher, 磨擦，转，词源同bore. -ct, 过去分词后缀。
n.磨擦,摩擦力The compact faction fractured because of friction.紧密小宗派由于摩擦破裂了.
【记】fiction（n 虚构；小说）描写人物friction
noun uncountable
FORCE 作用力
■the force which makes it difficult for one object to slide along the surface of another or to move through a liquid or gas 摩擦力；摩擦
•When you rub your hands together the friction produces heat.揉搓双手时，摩擦会产生热量。
['frɪk.ʃən] noun uncountable
DISAGREEMENT 分歧
■disagreement or unfriendliness caused by people having different opinions （观点不同者之间的）摩擦，不和
•There's a lot of friction between my wife and my mother.我妻子和我母亲之间有很多龃龉。
•Politics is a source of considerable friction in our family.政治问题在我们家是矛盾的一大根源。
•Border clashes have led to increased friction between the two countries.边境冲突引发了两国间更大的摩擦。
n. [力] 摩擦，摩擦力
- attrition, frottage

details.title: 笔记
details.text:
[联想] fiction虚构谎言 会引起 friction摩擦争执
fraction分数、部分、成分
fiction虚构、谎言、编造的事
fracture vt.& vi.（使）折断，破碎 n.破裂，断裂；骨折

entries.meaning: n.电冰箱
entries.example:
She can mend the fridge by herself.
她能自己修理冰箱。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
She can mend the fridge by herself.
她能自己修理冰箱。

The butter will soften out of the fridge.
黄油从冰箱中取出会变软。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 电冰箱; 冷冻机
分布：电冰箱(100%)
→缩写自refrigerator.
n.(refrigerator的略语)冰箱Please get me an ice cube out of the fridge.请替我从冰箱里拿块冰块来.
noun countable (also refrigerator) (US old-fashioned ice-box)
ADVANCED
■a piece of kitchen equipment which uses electricity to preserve food at a cold temperature 冰箱，电冰箱
•Don't forget to put the milk back in the fridge.别忘了把牛奶放回冰箱里。
n. 电冰箱
- electric refrigerator

entries.meaning:
n.朋友；支持者；友人
vt.与 ... 为友
entries.example:
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
患难之交才是真朋友。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
患难之交才是真朋友。

My friend invited me to dine out.
我的朋友邀请我出去吃饭。

I made friends with Bill in high school.
我和比尔在高中就成为朋友。

Mr. Green has been a friend of community charity.
格林先生一直是社区慈善事业的支持者。

He has been a good friend to me.
他一向是我的赞助者。

The death of his friend made him sad at heart.
友人之死使他十分伤心。

A joke never gains an enemy but loses a friend.
戏谑不能化敌为友，只能使人失去朋友。

Every man desiring to be a friend of this world makes himself a hater of God.
所以凡想要与世俗为友的，就是与神为敌了。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 朋友，友人; 资助者; 助手; 近亲
v. <诗>与…为友
分布：朋友(96%)，友人(3%)，支持者(1%)
→来自pri, 爱，友爱，词源同free, Frigga. 引申词义朋友。
n.朋友For convenience of intensive study, he has an intense intention of making friend with me.为便于强化学习,他有和我交朋友的强烈意向.
noun countable
PERSON YOU LIKE 你喜爱的人
ESSENTIAL
■a person who you know well and who you like a lot, but who is usually not a member of your family 朋友，友人
•She's my best/oldest/closest friend - we've known each other since we were five.她是我最要好／交情最久／最亲密的朋友——我们五岁的时候就认识了。
•He's a family friend/friend of the family.他是全家人的朋友。
•This restaurant was recommended to me by a friend of mine.这间餐厅是我的一个朋友给我推荐的。
•We've been friends for years.我们已是多年的朋友了。
•José and Pilar are (good) friends of ours.何塞和皮拉尔是我们的（好）朋友。
•We're (good) friends with José and Pilar.我们和何塞、皮拉尔是（好）朋友。
•She said that she and Peter were just (good) friends (= they were not having a sexual relationship).她说自己和彼得只是（好）朋友而已。
•I've made a lot of friends in this job.我从事这份工作结交了很多朋友。
•He finds it difficult to make friends.他发现交朋友很难。
⇒ See also befriend
■someone who is not an enemy and who you can trust 自己人；盟友
•You don't have to pretend anymore - you're among friends now.你不用再装了——现在大家都是自己人。
Common Learner Errors friendWarning: Choose the correct verb!To talk about starting a friendly relationship with someone, don't say 'meet/find/get friends', say make friends :
✗ If you don't speak English, it's hard to meet friends.If you don't speak English, it's hard to make friends.
[frend] noun countable
PERSON GIVING MONEY 捐资者
■someone who gives money to a theatre, other arts organization or charity in order to support it （剧院等艺术机构或慈善组织的）捐资者，赞助人
•The Friends of the Royal Academy raised £10 000 towards the cost of the exhibition.皇家艺术学院之友为此次展览筹集了一万英镑。
[frend] noun countable
A friend in need (is a friend indeed). saying
■This means that a friend who helps you when you really need help is a true friend. 患难之交才是真朋友。
[frend] noun countable
have friends in high places
■to know important people who can help you get what you want 有身居高位的朋友
[frend] noun countable
What are friends for? (also That's what friends are for.) saying
■said to a friend who has thanked you for doing something special for them 否则要朋友干甚么？
[frend] noun countable
With friends like you , who needs enemies ? humorous saying
■said to or about someone who says he or she is your friend but who is treating you very badly 像你这样的朋友和敌人有甚么区别？
acquaintance, pal, mate, friend
这组词都有“朋友”的意思，其区别是：
acquaintance: 指彼此相识，但交往不甚密切，相互间没有深厚情感的人。
pal: 口语用词，指十分要好的朋友。
mate: 最普通用词，既可指好友、同事，又可指合伙人，还可指配偶的一方。
friend: 一般用词，指某人喜爱并乐意与之相交往的人。
n. 朋友；助手；赞助者
- assistant, fellow, aid

entries.meaning: n.友谊；友好
entries.example:
Take this ring as a pledge of our friendship.
请接受这个戒指作为我们友谊的信物。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Take this ring as a pledge of our friendship.
请接受这个戒指作为我们友谊的信物。

Real friendship is more valuable than money.
真正的友谊比金钱更宝贵。

He swore eternal friendship with me.
他发誓和我永远友好。

He rebuffed all my offers of friendship.
他拒绝了我的一切友好表示。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 友情，友谊; 友善的关系; 友善，好意
分布：友谊(95%)，友好(5%)
→来自friend,朋友。-ship, 抽象名词后缀。
友谊(friend朋友)[-ship 1.表示某种关系或状态2.表示某种技能]
n.友谊,友好Their friendship lasted for twenty years.他们的友谊持续了二十年.
noun countable or uncountable
IMPROVER
■when two people are friends 友谊
•Their friendship goes back to when they were at school together.他们的友谊可追溯到学生时代。
•Did you form any close/lasting friendships while you were at college?你上大学时是否与人建立了亲密／持久的友谊？
•I value her friendship above anything else.我把她的友谊看得比甚么都重。
n. 友谊；友爱；友善
- fellowship, companionship

entries.meaning:
vt.使惊吓；害怕
vi.惊吓
entries.example:
It is illegal to frighten a pigeon.
惊吓鸽子是违法的。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
It is illegal to frighten a pigeon.
惊吓鸽子是违法的。

They tried to frighten the public into obedience.
他们企图吓唬群众使他们屈服。

He frightened the old man into giving him all the money.
他恐吓那位老人把所有的钱都给了他。

You frighten me, even though you're gentle with me.
你使我害怕,尽管你对我很温柔。

The little baby was frightened by the fierce dog.
那个小孩被恶狗吓坏了。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
vt. 使惊恐，使恐慌; 吓走，赶走
vi. 害怕，惊恐
时态：frightened, frightening, frightens
分布：害怕(45%)，惊吓(40%)，使惊吓(15%)
v.使惊恐The bright fighter is frightened and flies upright in straight line from the right.那架明亮的战斗机受到惊吓后呈直线地从右边垂直飞起来.
verb transitive
ESSENTIAL
■to make someone feel fear 使害怕，使受惊
•He frightens me when he drives so fast.他开车这么快，我很害怕。
•You'll frighten the baby wearing that mask.你戴那个面具会吓着宝宝的。
•The noise frightened me to death/out of my wits (= gave me a severe fright).那声音吓得我要死／不知所措。
['fraɪ.tən] verb transitive
Phrasal Verbs frighten sb/sth away/off
■to make a person or animal feel fear in order to make them go away 把…吓走
•Be quiet or you'll frighten the deer off.别出声，否则会把鹿吓跑的。
■to make someone so nervous that they decide not to do something 使某人紧张得不去做某事
•Many potential buyers were frightened off by the £1 million price tag.很多潜在的买家看到这个一百万英镑的价格标签后都望而却步。
['fraɪ.tən] verb transitive
Phrasal Verbs frighten sb into sth
■to make someone so frightened that they do something they did not want to do 把（某人）吓得…
vi. 害怕，惊恐
- be nervous of, be fearful of

entries.meaning: prep.出自；来自；从( ... 起)
entries.example:
He descended from a good family.
他出自名门。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
He descended from a good family.
他出自名门。

From what author does this quotation come?
这一引文出自哪位作者?

My answer seemed to come from the subconscious.
我的回答似乎出自下意识。

I had a phone call from Mary.
我接到了玛丽的电话。

We are all here, but we come from afar.
虽然我们此时在这儿，但我们来自远方。

The child got his nurture from his loving parents.
这个孩子的教育来自他慈爱的双亲。

The train starts from Beijing.
这辆火车从北京开出。

The shop is open from this day onwards.
该店从今天起开始营业。
