[teɪl] verb transitive
Phrasal Verbs tail back UK
■If traffic tails back, it forms a long line and moves very slowly or stops （车辆）排起长龙
•There is traffic tailing back along the motorway for ten miles because of road repairs.由于道路维修，车辆在高速公路上排起了十英里的长龙。
[teɪl] verb transitive
Phrasal Verbs tail off
■to reduce in amount or become lower in level 逐渐变小，逐渐减弱
•His voice tailed off as he drifted into sleep.他迷迷糊糊地快睡着了，说话声越来越小。
•The profits tailed off after a few years.几年后，利润越来越少。
n. 尾部；辫子；踪迹；燕尾服
- track, rump
vt. 尾随；装上尾巴
- dog, shadow
vi. 跟踪；变少或缩小
- follow up the scent
adj. 尾部的；从后面而来的
- caudal

entries.meaning:
n.裁缝
vt.缝制；调整使适合
vi.做裁缝
entries.example:
This tailor is famous for making good suit.
这位裁缝以做高级西装而出名。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
This tailor is famous for making good suit.
这位裁缝以做高级西装而出名。

The tailor made a suit for Dick.
这位裁缝师为迪克做了一套西装。

He tailored me a tweed suit.
他为我缝制了一套苏格兰粗呢的衣服。

He wears a beautifully tailored suit.
他穿了一套定做的漂亮西装。

We can tailor our design to meet your request.
我们能调整我们的设计以满足你的要求。

Computer adaptive testing uses computer technology to tailor exams to a person.
计算机自适应测试采用计算机技术使考试适合每个人的能力。

He established himeself as a tailor.
他以做裁缝为业。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 裁缝，成衣工
vi. 做裁缝
vt. 调整使适应; 为…裁制衣服; 为…做衣服; 剪裁，制作
时态：tailored, tailoring, tailors
分布：裁缝(95%)，做裁缝(3%)，缝制(1%)，调整使适合(1%)
→来自古法语 tailleor,裁缝，来自 tailler,剪，切，来自拉丁语 taliare,分开，剪开，来自 talea,砍， 小枝，嫩枝，词源同 tally,retail.
裁缝[tail=cut,表示"剪,割"]
n.裁缝v.缝制,剪裁Details about the tailor's tail are available from the prevailing dailies.有关我缝在尾巴的细节可从流行的日报上得到.
US [-lɚ] noun countable
■someone whose job is to repair, make and make changes to clothes, especially someone who makes jackets, trousers, coats, etc. for men 裁缝
UK ['teɪ.lər] US [-lɚ] verb transitive
■to make or prepare something following particular instructions 专门制作，使适应特定需要
n. [服装] 裁缝
- dressmaker, needlecraft, sartor, seamster

entries.meaning:
v.拿；取；执行；需要；接受；理解；修(课程)；花费；吃（喝）；认为；搭乘
n.拿取；取得物
entries.example:
Please take the trash to the garbage can.
请将垃圾拿到垃圾筒去。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Please take the trash to the garbage can.
请将垃圾拿到垃圾筒去。

Take money from the bank when needed.
需要时,把钱从银行里取出来。

We are ready to take your order.
我们随时准备执行您的命令。

It takes a lot of money to live in that city.
要住在那个城市需要花不少钱。

Bob did not take the job because it was a blind alley.
鲍勃没有接受此职，因为它没有发展前途。

I hope you will take the advice in good part.
我希望你能愉快地接受这劝告。

How am I supposed to take that remark?
我应该怎么理解那话的意思?

I shall take literature and mathematics this spring.
今年春天我要修文学及数学。

How long will it take me to get there?
到那儿要花多长时间？

She took another sip of tea.
她又喝了一小口茶。

I take this seriously. It's a matter of principle.
我对此很认真。这是原则问题。

She always takes the bus in order to save some money.
为了可以节省钱,她总是搭乘公车。

Love includes gives and takes.
爱情包含着给予和索取。

The lioness brought her take to her baby.
母狮子把捕获的猎物叼给了狮宝宝。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
vt. 拿，取; 采取; 接受（礼物等）; 耗费（时间等）
vi. 拿; 获得
n. 镜头; 看法; 收入额; 场景
时态：took, taken, taking, takes
分布：取(34%)，需要(20%)，拿(19%)，接受(11%)，认为(6%)，花费(5%)，搭乘(3%)，执行(1%)，理解(1%)
→来自古英语 tacan,抓住，拿走，来自 Proto-Germanic*tak,抓住，拿走，可能来自 tag,接触， 操纵，控制，词源同 tangent,tact.
v.拿取;吃;记录;取得;花费;捕获;认为The spy is shy of taking shelter on the shelf of the shell-like shed.间谍怕在壳子一样的棚里的架子上栖身.
verb (took, taken)
REMOVE 移开
ESSENTIAL transitive
■to remove something, especially without permission 拿；夺取；取走
•Has anything been taken (= stolen) ?丢了甚么东西吗？
•Here's your pen, I took it by mistake.你的笔在这里，我拿错了。
•All possessions had been taken from her.她所有财产都被剥夺了。
ADVANCED transitive
■to subtract a number (= remove it from another number) 减
•If you take 4 from 12 you get 8.12减4得8。
⇒ See also take sth away
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
MOVE 移动
ESSENTIAL transitive
■to move something or someone from one place to another 拿走，带走
•The weather forecast said rain, so take your umbrella (with you) when you go out.天气预报说有雨，所以外出时记得带伞。
•The suitcases were taken to Madrid by mistake.由于疏忽，手提箱被带到马德里了。
•Take the book up/down to the third floor of the library.把书拿到图书馆的四楼。
•[+ two objects] I suggested that he should take her some chocolates/take some chocolates to her (= bring them to her as a present).我建议他给她带些巧克力。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
ACCEPT 接受
ESSENTIAL transitive
■to accept or have 接受，接纳；收受
•Do they take credit cards here?他们这里接受信用卡吗？
•Do you take milk in your tea?你茶里要放牛奶吗？
•This container will take (= has room for) six litres.这种容器容量为六升。
•Which newspaper do you take (= regularly buy) ?你常买哪种报纸？
•He continually abuses her, and she just sits there and takes it.他不断辱骂她，而她只坐在那里默默忍受。
•If you think I'm going to take that lying down (= accept it without complaining) , you're very much mistaken.如果你认为我会甘心忍受那一切，那你就大错特错了。
•I take the /your point (= accept the argument) , but I still don't think you should have gone.我接受你的辩解，可我还是认为你原本就不应该去。
take part IMPROVER
■to be involved in an activity with other people 参与，参加
•She doesn't usually take part in any of the class activities.她一般不参加班里的所有活动。
ADVANCED transitive
■used when you want to mention something as a particular example of what you are talking about 以…为例
•I've been very busy recently. Take last week, I had meetings on four evenings.我最近非常忙。就拿上星期来说，我有四个晚上在开会。
take to be/take for sth
■If you take someone or something to be something, or if you take them for something, you accept or believe that they are that thing 认为；把…看作
•[+ to infinitive] These creatures are generally taken to be descended from primitive fishes.这些生物通常被认为是从原始鱼类演变而来的。
•I could have taken him for (= believed that he was) your brother.我差点把他当成了你的兄弟。
•I'm not going to forge his signature for you! What do you take me for? (= You should not believe I could do a thing like that.)我不会帮你伪造他的签名的！你把我当成甚么人了？
can't take sth
■to not be able to deal with an unpleasant situation 不能承受…；不能应对…
•I can't take it any more. I'm leaving.我无法再忍受。我要走了。
take it or leave it
■accept or refuse the offer completely 接不接受由你，要不要随你的便
•That's my final offer - you can take it or leave it.那是我最后的报价——接不接受由你。
Common Learner Errors take partThe correct preposition to use after take part is in.Don't say 'take part at/of something', say take part in something :My team would like to take part in the competition.
Common Learner Errors take part or take place?Warning: choose the correct verb!To talk about something happening, don't say something 'takes part', say something takes place :
✗ The concert will take part at the Albert Hall, in London.The concert will take place at the Albert Hall, in London.
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
HOLD 握
ESSENTIAL transitive
■to move in order to hold something in the hand(s) 手执，握住，抓住
•Can you take this bag while I open the door?你帮我拿一下袋子，我去开门，好吗？
•He took my arm and led me outside.他拉住我的手臂，领我到门外。
•Take an egg and break it into the bowl.拿一个鸡蛋打在碗里。
•He took hold of the plant's root and pulled.他抓住植物的根部往上拔。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
GO WITH 一起去
ESSENTIAL transitive
■to go somewhere with someone, often paying for them or being responsible for them 带（某人）去（某地）
•We're taking the children to the zoo on Saturday.星期六我们要带孩子们去动物园。
•[+ to infinitive] I took my elderly parents to look at some new houses.我带着年迈的父母看了一些新盖的房子。
•[+ -ing verb] Will you take me swimming tomorrow?你明天带我去游泳好吗？
IMPROVER transitive
■to show someone how to get to somewhere by going there with them 给（某人）带路，引领
•Let me take you to your room.我带你去你的房间吧。
transitive
■to go to a social event with someone 带（某人）参加（社交活动）
•Who's taking you to the dance?谁带你去参加舞会？
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
TRANSPORT 运输
ESSENTIAL transitive
■to travel somewhere by using a particular form of transport or a particular vehicle, route, etc. 搭乘（交通工具）
•I always take the train - it's less hassle than a car.我总是乘火车——乘火车比开车省事。
•She took the 10.30 flight to Edinburgh.她乘十点半的飞机去爱丁堡。
•If you take the road on the left, you'll come to the post office.走左边的路就能到邮局。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
NEED 需要
ESSENTIAL transitive
■to need 要求，需要
•Parachuting takes a lot of nerve.跳伞需要很大勇气。
•I take a size five in shoes.我穿五号鞋。
•Transitive verbs take a direct object.及物动词带直接受词。
•[+ -ing verb] His story took some believing (= was difficult to believe).他的故事令人难以置信。
ESSENTIAL [L only + noun]
■If something takes a particular time, that period is needed in order to complete it 花费（时间）
•The cooking process only takes ten minutes.烹饪过程只需十分钟。
•[+ to infinitive] How long does this paint take to dry?这种油漆要多久才能亁？
•[+ obj + noun] It took us all day to drive home.我们花了一整天时间开车回家。
not take long IMPROVER
■to act or happen over a short period of time 不久
•I'm just going to the shops - I won't take long.我只是去商店买点东西——不会花太长时间的。
take time IMPROVER
■to need a long time 需要很长时间
•Broken bones always take time to mend.骨折总是要很长时间才能痊愈。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
DRUG/MEDICINE 药物／药
ESSENTIAL
■to swallow or use a medicine or drug, especially in a regular way 口服，服用（吞吃或使用一种药品或毒品，尤指定期吞吃或使用）
•Take this medicine three times a day.这种药每天服用三次。
•Do you think she takes drugs?你认为她在吸毒吗？
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
ACT 行动
IMPROVER transitive
■to do or perform 从事，进行
•The Archbishop took our service of thanksgiving.大主教为我们主持了感恩祈祷仪式。
•Shelley is taking (= studying) economics at university.谢莉在大学念经济学。
•UK Mr Marshall takes us for (= teaches us) physics.马歇尔先生教我们物理。
IMPROVER transitive
■used with many nouns to make a verb phrase that is equal in meaning to the related verb （后接名词形成动宾结构词组，其意思相当于相应动词）
•I think we'll take a break (= we'll stop for a break) there.我想我们将在那里休息一会儿。
•If you're tired you should take a rest (= you should rest).如果累了，你就应该休息一下。
•I always like to take a walk (= to walk) after lunch.午饭后，我总喜欢散散步。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
THINK ABOUT 想
IMPROVER transitive
■to think about something or someone in a particular way （以某一种特殊方式）思考，考虑
•We're taking the bomb threats very seriously.我们非常重视炸弹恐吓事件。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
REACTION 反应
IMPROVER transitive
■to have or come to have a particular feeling or opinion （在思想上）产生，形成；感受到
•He doesn't take any interest in his children.他对孩子们漠不关心。
•Don't take any notice of the cameras.不要理会照相机。
•She takes offence too easily.她很容易生气。
•They took pity on the stray cat and fed it.他们可怜那只流浪猫，就给了它些食物。
•I take the view that fuel should be heavily taxed to reduce road use.我认为应该对燃料课以重税，以减少公路上的车辆。
take sb unawares (also take sb by surprise)
■to surprise someone 令（某人）大吃一惊
•The sudden noise took her unawares.那突如其来的巨响吓了她一跳。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
MONEY 钱
ADVANCED transitive
■to receive money from sales or as payment for entrance to an event 收取，收入
•The show took an astonishing $100 000 in its first week.这次演出第一个星期就收入十万美元。
⇒ See also takings
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
CATCH 抓
ADVANCED transitive
■to get possession of something or someone 夺取，攻取
•Rebels ambushed the train and took several prisoners.叛乱者伏击火车，俘虏了一些人。
take 1 2. The Liberals need just 200 more votes to take the seat from Labour.
自由党只需再获得200票，就可以从工党手中夺过该席位。
•Centre-left parties look set to take power.中间偏左的党派看来很可能要掌权。
•Adam, I'd like you to take control of the aircraft now.亚当，我想现在让你来操控飞机。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
WRITE 写
transitive
■to write 写；记录
•I hope you're all taking notes.我希望你们都记笔记。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
PERFORM WELL 表现好
intransitive
■to work or perform as expected 起作用；奏效，显出效果
•These new plants haven't taken - they don't like this dry soil.这些新植物长得不好——它们不适应这种干燥的土壤。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
be like taking candy from a baby (be as easy as taking candy from a baby) US informal
■to be very easy 轻而易举的
•Beating them was the easiest thing in the world - it was like taking candy from a baby.打败他们是世上最容易的事情——就像从小孩手里抢糖果一样容易。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
can take it or leave it
■said about something that you quite like, but that you do not love or need strongly 要不要都可以；接不接受都可以
•My sister's absolutely crazy about chocolate whereas I can take it or leave it.我妹妹酷爱巧克力，而我吃不吃都无所谓。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
I take it (also can take it)
■said if you think that what you say is likely to be true, although it is not proved 我猜想，我认为
•You'll be staying the night, I take it?我想你今晚会住这里吧？
•So we can take it you've resigned?那就是说你辞职了？
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
if you take my meaning UK
■used to say that you have left out information or your opinion from what you have just said, but that you expect the person listening still to understand it 如果你明白我的意思（指弦外之音）
•Let's just say we had 'problems', if you take my meaning.我们就姑且说我们遇到了“问题”吧，如果你明白我所指的是甚么的话。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
point taken
■used to say you accept what someone has said 接受（观点）
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
take your time
■said to mean that you can spend as much time as you need in doing something, or that you should slow down 不着急，慢慢来 disapproving
■to do something too slowly 做事磨蹭
•The builders are really taking their time.那些建筑工人真会拖拖拉拉。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
take one (thing) at a time
■to do or deal with one thing before starting to do or deal with another （对问题）一个个来处理
•There are a few problems, but let's take one thing at a time.现在有一些问题，不过我们得一个个来处理。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Take that! informal
■said as someone hits someone else, especially in humorous films or cartoons （尤指喜剧电影或卡通片中打人时的用语）看招！吃我一拳！
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
take the time
■to make the effort to do something 花费力气（做某事）
•She didn't even take the time to wish me good morning.她连停下来跟我说声早安都没有。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Take a walk! US informal
■an impolite way of telling someone to go away 走开，滚开（叫某人走开的一种不礼貌方式）
•The guy kept pestering her, and finally she told him to take a walk.那家伙不断骚扰她，最后她叫他滚开。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
will not take no for an answer
■to not allow someone to refuse what you have offered 不容拒绝，不接受别人说“不”
•I've told Steve I'm not interested, but he keeps asking me out - he won't take no for an answer.我已经告诉史蒂夫我没兴趣，可他还是不断请我出去——他就是不接受别人说“不”。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take sb aback
■to surprise or shock someone so much that they do not know how to behave for a short time 使（某人）大吃一惊
•I was a little taken aback at the directness of the question.问题问得如此直接，令我有点吃惊。
•The news really took us aback.这消息着实令我们吃了一惊。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take after sb ADVANCED
■to be similar to an older member of your family in appearance or character （在外貌、性格等方面）与（家庭中某个年纪较大成员）相像
•He takes after his mother/his mother's side of the family.他很像他母亲／他母亲家的人。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take against sb UK
■to begin to dislike someone 开始不喜欢（某人）
•I think she took against me when I got the promotion she wanted.我觉得我被提拔到她梦寐以求的职位后，她开始恨起我来了。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sth apart IMPROVER
■to separate something into its different parts 拆开；拆卸
•We took the engine apart to see what the problem was.我们拆开引擎看看问题出在哪里。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sb apart informal
■to defeat someone very easily in a sport （比赛中）把…打得一败涂地，轻松击败
•He took their defence apart, scoring three goals in the first twenty minutes.他轻而易举地突破了他们的防线，开场20分钟内就进了三球。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sth away
REMOVE
ESSENTIAL
■to remove something 拿走，移走
•Take these chairs away - we don't need them.拿走这些子——我们用不着。
•Supermarkets are taking business away from small local shops.大型超市正在抢走当地小商店的生意。
CALCULATE
ESSENTIAL
■to subtract a number (= remove it from another number) 减，减去
•Four take away two is two.4减2等于2。
•If you take 4 away from 12 you get 8.12减4等于8。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sth back
SOMETHING BOUGHT
IMPROVER
■to return something you have bought to a shop 退回（从商店里购买的东西）
•Is it too small? Take it back and get a refund.太小了吗？那就把它退回吧。
STATEMENT
ADVANCED
■to admit that something you said was wrong 收回（说错的话）
•All right, I take it all back. It wasn't your fault.好吧，我收回我说过的话。那不是你的错。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take sb back
PARTNER
[M]
■to allow a partner who previously left your home because of a disagreement or another relationship to come back to live with you 允许（因不和或婚外情而离去的配偶）回家，与（某人）重归于好
•His wife said she would never take him back.他妻子说她绝不会跟他和好。
MEMORY
■If something takes you back, it makes you remember a period or an event （某事）唤起（某人）的回忆
•That piece of music really took me back (to my schooldays).那首乐曲真的让我回想起从前（的学生时代）。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sth down
REMOVE
ADVANCED
■to remove something that is on a wall or something that is temporary, or to remove a structure by separating its different parts 拿下；拆掉；拆除
•I've taken the pictures down.我已经取下了那些画。
WRITE
■to write something that another person has just said 写下，记下
•He took down my address and phone number and said he'd phone back.他记下了我的地址和电话号码，说会回电话给我。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [often passive] take sth from sb
■If you take words, information or ideas from another person or piece of work, you use or develop them in some way 从（某人处或某人作品中）引用（或借鉴）
•The plot is taken from Shakespeare.该情节源于莎士比亚的戏剧。
take it from me (also take my word for it)
■accept that what I say is true, because I know or have experienced it 听我的吧，我说的不会错
•It won't work - take it from me.那不会管用的——相信我说的吧。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take sth in
UNDERSTAND
ADVANCED [M]
■to understand completely the meaning or importance of something 领会，理解
•I had to read the letter twice before I could take it all in.我读了两遍，才把整封信看懂。
■2. It was an interesting exhibition, but there was too much to take in at once.
take 2 那是个很有意思的展览，但内容太多，让人目不暇给。
INCLUDE
■to include something 包括，包含
•The new town takes in three former villages.新市镇包括了以前的三个村庄。
WATCH mainly US
■to go to watch a film or performance, or to visit a place such as a museum 去观看；去参观
•I thought we might get something to eat and then take in a movie.我原本想，我们可以先吃点东西，然后去看电影。
CLOTHES [M]
■to make a piece of clothing narrower, by changing the position of some of the stitching joining it together 改小（衣服）
•I'll have to take this dress in at the waist - it's too big.我得把这条裙子的腰身改小点——它太大了。
WORK [M]
■to do paid work for other people, such as washing or sewing, in your home 在家做（替别人洗衣、缝纫等事情）赚钱
•She supported her family by taking in laundry.她靠在家替别人洗衣服养家。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sb in
CARE FOR
■to take care of someone and provide a place in your home for them 收留，收容，收养（某人）
•Several families take in foreign students.有几个家庭接待外国留学生。
DECEIVE [often passive]
■to cause someone to believe something which is not true, or to trick or deceive someone 欺骗
•I can't believe she was taken in by him.我简直不敢相信她被他骗了。
POLICE
■If the police take you in, they take you to the police station （员警）带（某人）去警察局
•Detectives on the murder inquiry have taken in a new suspect for questioning.调查这宗谋杀案的侦探们又带了一个新的嫌疑人来警察局进行审讯。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sth off
REMOVE
ESSENTIAL
■to remove something, especially clothes 脱下，脱掉（尤指衣服）
•He took off his clothes and got into the bath.他脱掉衣服，进入浴室。
•After the poisoning scare, the product was taken off the shelves/the market (= removed from sale).发生担心中毒的恐慌后，该产品被撤下了货架／撤出了市场。
NOT WORK
ADVANCED
■to spend time away from your work 休假
•He took off two weeks in September.他九月份休了两周假。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take off
FLY
IMPROVER
■If an aircraft, bird or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly 起飞；飞起
•The plane took off at 8.30 a.m.飞机上午八点半起飞。
⇒ See also take-off
SUCCEED
ADVANCED
■to suddenly start to be successful or popular 突然开始成功；开始走红
•Her singing career had just begun to take off.她的歌唱事业刚刚起飞。
LEAVE informal
■to suddenly leave somewhere, usually without telling anyone that you are going （常指不打招呼就）突然离开
•When he saw me, he took off in the other direction.他一看见我就往另外一个方向躲开了。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sb off UK informal
■to copy the way a particular person speaks or behaves, or the way something is done, usually in order to entertain other people 模仿
•She's really good at taking people off.她模仿别人模仿得真像。
⇒ See also take-off Compare impersonate
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sth on
ADVANCED
■to accept a particular job or responsibility 接受（工作）；承担（责任）
•She took too much on and made herself ill.她承担的任务太重，结果病倒了。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take on sth
■to begin to have a particular quality 开始具有（某种特征）；呈现；露出
•Her voice took on a troubled tone.从她说话的声音里能听出她遇到了麻烦。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sb on
EMPLOY
ADVANCED
■to employ someone 雇用（某人）
•She was taken on as a laboratory assistant.她受雇为实验室助理。
FIGHT
■to compete against or fight someone 同…较量（或争斗）
•The Government took on the unions and won.政府跟工会进行了一番较量后，取得了胜利。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sth out IMPROVER
■to remove something from somewhere 移走，移开
•I've had a tooth taken out.我拔了一颗牙。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sb out IMPROVER
■to go somewhere and do something with someone, usually something you plan and pay for 带（某人）出去
•Dad's taking the whole family out to the cinema.爸爸要带全家去看电影。
•Our boss took us out for a meal.我们老板带我们出去吃饭。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sb/sth out slang
■to kill someone or destroy something 杀死（某人）；摧毁（某物）
•The soldiers said that they were trying to take out the snipers.士兵说他们正设法除掉那些狙击手。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take sth out of sb
take it out of sb (also take a lot out of sb)
■to make someone very tired 使（某人）筋疲力尽
•Digging in the garden certainly takes it out of me these days.这段时间，在园子里翻地真把我累翻了。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take sb out of themselves UK
■to change someone's mood and stop them from thinking about what was making them unhappy 使（某人）不再想不开心的事情
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sth out on sb ADVANCED
■to treat someone badly because you are upset or angry, even though they have done nothing wrong 向（某人）发泄，拿（某人）出气
•I know you've had a bad day, but there's no need to take it out on me!我知道你今天很不顺，可也没必要拿我出气！
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take (sth) over
START DOING
IMPROVER
■to start doing a job or being responsible for something that another person did or had responsibility for before 接任；接管，接手
•He took over from the previous headmaster in February.他二月接手了前任校长的工作。
•She took over as manager two weeks ago.她两周前接任经理一职。
•Colin Lamb has taken over responsibility for this project.科林‧兰姆已经接管了这个专案计划。
GET CONTROL
IMPROVER
■to get control of a company by buying most of its shares (= the equal parts into which the ownership of the company is divided) 接管，收购（公司）
•The company he works for has recently been taken over.他就职的那家公司最近被收购了。
⇒ See also takeover
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take sb round (sth/somewhere) ADVANCED
■to walk through a building or visit a place with someone, showing them the most interesting or important parts 带（某人）参观
•You will be taken round the museum by one of the guides.其中一个导游将会带领你们参观博物馆。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take sb through sth
■to explain something to someone 为（某人）解释，向（某人）说明
•I'll take you through it one more time, then you can try it yourself.我会再给你解释一遍，然后你自己试试。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take to sb/sth
■to start to like someone or something 开始喜欢；对…产生好感
•His wife took to her new neighbours at once.他妻子立刻喜欢上了新邻居。
•She's taken to tennis like a duck to water (= she likes it and is good at it).她如鱼得水似的喜欢上了网球。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take to sth
■to start doing something often 开始从事；形成…的习惯
•She was so depressed she took to drink.她十分抑郁，开始酗酒。
•[+ -ing verb] He's taken to staying out very late.他开始经常很晚才回来。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take to somewhere
■to go somewhere, usually because you are in a difficult or dangerous situation 去往；求助于
•The refugees took to the hills for safety.难民逃往山区避难。
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs [M] take sth up
FILL
IMPROVER
■to fill an amount of space or time 占去（地方或时间）
•This desk takes up too much room.这张桌子太占地方。
•Too much of this report is taken up with out-of-date figures.这份报告里尽是过期的资料。
START
ADVANCED
■to start doing a particular job or activity 开始从事
take 3 1. He's taken up the post of supervisor.
他刚刚担任监督员一职。
•[+ -ing verb] Have you ever thought of taking up acting ?你想过去当演员吗？
•Ian took up (= continued) the story where Sue had left off.伊恩接着讲休没有讲完的故事。
take up office
■to start an official job 上任
•The minister took up office in December.部长是在十二月上任的。
DISCUSS
■to discuss something or deal with something 讨论；处理
•The school took the matter up with the police.学校和警方一起处理此事。
•UK I'd like to take you up on your sales figures for June.我想和你谈谈你六月份的销售额。
•A leading law firm took up his case.一家顶尖的律师事务所接手了他的案子。
CLOTHING
■to shorten a piece of clothing, such as a skirt or trousers 把（裙子、裤子等）改短
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take sb up on sth
■to accept an offer that someone has made 接受
•Could I take you up on that offer of a lift, Rob?罗布，我现在同意乘你的车，还可以吗？
[teɪk] verb (took, taken)
Phrasal Verbs take up with sb
■to become friendly or start a relationship with someone, especially someone who might have a bad influence on you 开始与（尤指可能带来不良影响的人）来往
•She's taken up with a strange crowd of people.她开始与一帮古怪的人来往。
[teɪk] noun
MONEY 钱
uncountable
■money that is received from sales or as payment for entrance to an event 收取，收入
•The box office take was huge for the new show.这次新演出的票房收入很可观。
[teɪk] noun
FILM 电影
countable
■the filming of a scene (= small part of a film) （电影）一个镜头的拍摄
•This scene of the film needed ten takes before we felt it was right.电影里的这个镜头，我们拍了十次才满意。
[teɪk] noun
on the take US
■trying to profit in a personal and usually financial way from a situation 试图捞好处的
•I honestly don't trust him - he always seems to be on the take.说老实话，我真的不信任他——他似乎总想捞好处。
Compare be on the make at make
convey, fetch, get, transport, take, bring, carry
这组词都有“带、拿、取”的意思，其区别是：
convey: 指通过中间人传递信息，或以某种方式把人或物送到目的地。
fetch: 指一往一返，相当于go and bring，去取了东西或带人再返回到出发处。
get: 口语用词，与fetch基本同义，语气随便。
transport: 指使用车辆或机械设备把人或货物从一处运载到另一处。
take: 指从说话人或说话人心目中所在处把某人或某物带离开，带到离说话者有一定距离的地方，与bring的方向正相反，侧重方向，不着重方式。
bring: 指从某处把人或物带到或拿到说话者所在的地点，强调方向，不着重方式。
carry: 指把物品从一个地方带到另一个地方，不涉及方向，只强调方式。
take, pay, cost, spend
take: 物做主语,花时间;
pay: 人做主语,花钱,pay for;
cost: 物做主语,花钱
spend: 人做主语,花钱,花时间; spend…on sth./in doing sth;
take, expend, cost, spend
这组词都有“花费”的意思，其区别是：
take: 普通用词，指需要占用空间、时间或精力等，其主语可以是人，也可以是一件事情。
expend: 较正式用词，通常指为某一专门目的而花费大量金钱、时间或精力。
cost: 指花费时间、金钱、劳力等。其主语是物，而不能由人充当，也不用被动形式。
spend: 普通用词，与cost基本同义，但主语必须是人。
grasp, grab, clasp, seize, take, clutch, grip, snatch
这组词都有“抓住，握紧”的意思，其区别是：
grasp: 指紧紧抓住、抓牢。
grab: 指粗暴而急迫的抓住。
clasp: 指用手紧握或用臂紧抱。
seize: 指突然抓住某物，强调突然的猛烈动作。
take: 最普通用词，不带感情色彩。指用手抓、取某东西或控制某物。
clutch: 强调匆忙、紧急地抓、抓紧。
grip: 语气比grasp强，指用手的最大力量紧紧抓住。
snatch: 指突然抢走，侧重动作更快或更具暴力性质。
take, accept, admit, receive
这组词都有“接受、接纳”的意思，其区别是：
take: 与receive同意，是receive的日常用法，侧重不带主观意愿地收下或接受。
accept: 强调主动地或自愿地接受，或者说，经过考虑后同意接受。
admit: 作“接受”讲时，强调准许或批准。
receive: 着重仅仅接到或收到这一支轮船或事实，而不含采取主动或积极行动的意思。
vt. 拿，取；采取；吃；接受
- carry, adopt, have, eat, assume
vi. 拿；获得
- pick up, get access to

entries.meaning:
n.故事；叙述；传说
v.谈论，讲述，搬弄是非；
entries.example:
Their love story sounds like a fairy tale.
他们的爱情故事听起来像童话。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Their love story sounds like a fairy tale.
他们的爱情故事听起来像童话。

This is a tale that wring the heart.
这是个令人心痛的故事。

We listened to their tales about life in the Sahara Desert.
我们听他们讲述撒哈拉沙漠的生活经历。

According to the tale, the tears of shark-people can be turned into pearls.
传说中鲛人泪可以化为珍珠。

The Monkey King' is an extraordinary tale with a strange twist at the end.
美猴王是个离奇的传说，结尾有意想不到的波折。

It's an ancient tale which appears in various guises in several languages.
那是一个以几种语言叙述的古老的故事。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 传说，传言; （尤指充满惊险的）故事; 坏话，谣言; 〈古〉计算，总计
分布：故事(84%)，传说(12%)，叙述(4%)
→来自古英语 talu,计算，数数，故事，寓言，来自 Proto-Germanic*talo,计算，告知，来自 del, 瞄准，计算，思考，词源同 tell,teller,talk.
n.故事,传说The males think the females have talent for telling stale tales.男人认为女人有讲陈腐故事的才能.
noun countable
IMPROVER
■a story, especially one which might be invented or difficult to believe （尤指包含离奇内容的）故事，不实之词
•He told some fascinating tales about his life in India.他讲了他在印度生活的一些奇闻轶事。
•She told me/invented/concocted a tale about missing the bus to explain her lateness.为了解释迟到的原因，她向我讲了／编造了一通没赶上公车的鬼话。
[teɪl] noun countable
tale of woe
■a report of the bad things that have happened 悲惨的故事
•I asked how he was and he gave me a real tale of woe.我问他过得怎么样，他向我诉说他的不幸。
story, tale, fiction, fable, romance, novel
这组词都有“小说，故事”的意思，其区别是：
story: 指篇幅较短，常包含一系列情节或事件，口述或书写成文的故事。
tale: 常可与story换用，指以事实为中心作叙述的故事，也指古代流传下来的传说故事或神话故事。
fiction: 指部分或全部虚构的短篇、中篇、长篇小说，也指传奇故事，是小说的总称。
fable: 指短小而寓有教育意义的虚构故事。故事的主人公多为拟人化的动物或非动物之类。也作传说解。
romance: 系novel早期的代用词，泛指具有强烈神话和传奇色彩的故事，现指爱情故事。
novel: 指任何有情节、人物、对白，虚构的长篇散文体故事。
n. 故事；传说；叙述；流言蜚语
- relation, story, tradition, statement, narrative

entries.meaning: n.天赋；才能，才艺；天才；人才；<英俚>美人
entries.example:
He has great talent, but he has lost his faith.
他很有天赋，但是他已经丧失了信心。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
He has great talent, but he has lost his faith.
他很有天赋，但是他已经丧失了信心。

The mother found that her son had a musical talent.
母亲发现儿子有音乐天赋。

Her talents are well known.
人人都知道她很有才干。

His talent was largely self-developed.
他的才能主要是自己培养的。

What they need most is managerial talent.
他们最需要的是管理人才。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 天资，才能; 天才，人才; 塔兰特，古代的一种计量单位，可用来记重量或作为货币单位; <旧，非正式>性感的人
分布：人才(58%)，天赋(24%)，天才(18%)
→来自拉丁语 talentum,重量，一定数目的钱，来自希腊语 talanton,称量，一定的重量，一定数 目的钱，来自 tele,举起，称重，词源同 extol,tolerate.据考证，1 talent 为 6000 古希腊货 币 drachma,在当时为一大笔钱。现词义来自圣经的一则寓言，讲得是主人要出远门，按能力 给了三个奴隶一个 5 talenta,一个 2 talenta,一个 1talent,很久以后主人回来了，前两个奴隶用钱 投资钱生钱，最后一个奴隶把钱埋在地底下，主人生气的说，即使你不会投资，你把钱存入 银行至少也有利息啊，我要没收你的钱，把钱交给有能力的人。后引申词义天才，天资等。
n.才能,天资;人才The males think the females have talent for telling stale tales.男人认为女人有讲陈腐故事的才能.
noun
NATURAL ABILITY 天分
ESSENTIAL countable or uncountable
■(someone who has) a natural ability to be good at something, especially without being taught 天分，天赋；天才，有天分者
•Her talent for music showed at an early age.她小时候就表现出了音乐天赋。
•His artistic talents were wasted in his boring job.他的艺术天分被枯燥乏味的工作消磨殆尽。
['tæl.ənt] noun
ATTRACTIVE PEOPLE 有吸引力的人
uncountable UK slang mainly humorous
■people who are sexually attractive 尤物
•There was plenty of talent at the party last night.昨晚的派对上有许多佳丽。
gift, genius, aptitude, talent, capacity, capability, faculty, ability, competence
这组词都有“能力，才能”的意思，其区别是：
gift: 着重个人的天赋的才能或在某方面的显著本领，常暗含不能用一般规律作解释的意味。
genius: 语气最强，指天赋的高度才能与智力。
aptitude: 多指先天或后天习得的运用自如的能力，常暗示接受能力强，能迅速掌握一种学术训练或艺术技巧。
talent: 着重指人某方面具有可发展和倍养的突出天赋才能，但语意比genius弱。
capacity: 侧重指人的潜在能力，通常不指体力，多指才智，尤指接受与领悟能力。
capability: 多用于人，指胜任某项具体工作的能力，也指本身具有、尚未发挥的潜在能力。常与of或for连用。
faculty: 指特殊的才能或智力。
ability: 普通用词，指人先天的或学来的各种能力。
competence: 正式用词，侧重指令人满意的业务能力与水平，达到胜任某项工作等的要求。
n. 才能；天才；天资
- capability, ability, quality, genius, endowment

entries.meaning:
v.交谈；商讨；演讲；阐述；劝服
n.谈话；会谈；讨论；讲话；空谈
entries.example:
I wish to talk with you in private.
我希望能私下里同你谈话。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
I wish to talk with you in private.
我希望能私下里同你谈话。

We need to hold another meeting next week to talk about some technical problems.
我们需要在下周再举行一次会议,来讨论一些技术性的问题。

In the hall a woman was talking on diet and health.
在那个大厅里,一名女性正在就饮食与健康发表演讲。

He went on to talk about the world situation at present.
他接着又阐述了当期的世界形势。

I had a long talk with her that night.
那天晚上,我和她秉烛长谈。

The talks between the two premiers will be held next month.
两国总理的会谈将于下月举行。

The officers held a long talk about the price control and pay rise.
官员们就价格调控和工资上涨进行了长时间的讨论。

She delivered a talk on philosophy to the society.
她给学会作了一次有关哲学的讲话。

In politics there is too much talk and not enough action.
在政治方面向来是说得多做得少。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
v. 说话; 讨论; 讲，说; 说闲话
n. 交谈; 讨论; 报告; 空话
时态：talked, talking, talks
分布：谈话(36%)，交谈(17%)，讨论(16%)，讲话(12%)，会谈(7%)，演讲(7%)，空谈(3%)，商讨(1%)，阐述(1%)
→来自 tell,告诉，告知，-k,表反复或强调，比较 hear,hark,steal,stalk.
n.谈话;聊天;讲话;演讲v.说话;交谈The systematic items stem from the walker's talk about the chalk.这些系统的条款来源于步行者关于粉笔的谈话.
US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
ESSENTIAL
■to say words aloud; to speak to someone 讲话，谈话；谈论
•We were just talking about Simon's new girlfriend.我们刚才在谈论赛门的新女友。
•My little girl has just started to talk.我的小女儿刚开始说话。
•She talks to her mother on the phone every week.她每周都跟母亲通电话。
talk business/politics, etc.
■to discuss a particular subject 谈论正事／政治等
•Whenever they're together, they talk politics.他们一在一起就谈论政治。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
be like talking to a brick wall
■If talking to someone is like talking to a brick wall, the person you are speaking to does not listen 白说；对牛弹琴（如果和某人说话就像“和砖墙说话”，那就等于白说，那人根本没有聆听）
•I've tried to discuss my feelings with her, but it's like talking to a brick wall.我曾经试着和她讨论我对她的感受，但好像是对牛弹琴。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
give sb something to talk about (UK set sb talking)
■to provide someone with an interesting subject to discuss 成为（某人）谈论的话题
•Our new car will give the neighbours something to talk about.我们的新车会成为邻居的话题。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Look who's talking! (also You're a fine one to talk!) (also You can/can't talk!) (US also You should talk!) informal
■something you say when someone criticizes you for something that they do themselves 亏你有脸说别人！
•I'm lazy? You're a fine one to talk!我懒？亏你有脸说别人！
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk sb's head off informal
■to talk to someone for a long time, usually loudly 对（某人）喋喋不休
•She talked my head off.她对我喋喋不休地说了半天。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk a blue streak US informal
■to talk quickly and without stopping 滔滔不绝，口若悬河
•He talked a blue streak all through breakfast.他吃早餐时一直滔滔不绝地说话。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk about ... informal
■used to emphasize that something is very noticeable in the stated way （用于加强语气）说到…可真不得了
•What a film - talk about boring!那部电影可真是无聊透顶！
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk dirty informal
■to describe sexual acts to another person using rude words 说下流话
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk nonsense (UK also talk rubbish)
■to talk without making sense 胡说；说无意义的话
•Is it just me or was she talking nonsense in the meeting?在会议上说废话的只有我，还是也包括她呢？
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk sense
■to speak in a reasonable way 说得有理
•Why don't you talk sense!你怎么说话不讲理！
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk shop
■to talk about your job with those you work with when not at work （与同事在工作时间外）谈论自己的工作
•Even at a party they have to talk shop!就是在派对上，他们还是三句不离本行！
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk the hind leg(s) off a donkey UK informal
■to talk without stopping for a long time 喋喋不休
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk the talk... walk the walk
■If you say that someone talks the talk but does not walk the walk, you mean that they do not act in a way that agrees with the things they say. 说一套，做一套
•When it comes to recycling he talks the talk but he doesn't walk the walk.在废物回收利用这个问题上，他是说一套做一套。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk through your hat informal
■to talk about something without understanding what you are talking about 信口开河，随口乱说
•Nothing of what he said made sense - he was talking through his hat.他说的话没一点道理——他只是随口乱说。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talk turkey US informal
■to discuss something honestly and directly 坦率认真地谈话
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
talking of sb/sth (also speaking of sb/sth) ADVANCED
■while we are talking about a particular person or thing 说起，谈起
•Talking of John, I saw a friend of his last week.说起约翰，我上周见到他的一个朋友。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs talk at sb
■to speak to someone without listening to them or allowing them to speak （不顾对方如何反应）向（某人）大发议论，滔滔不绝地对（某人）说
•What discussion? You weren't talking to me, you were talking at me!那是甚么讨论？你不是在跟我交谈，一直都是你在说，根本不容我说！
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs talk back
■If a child talks back, they reply rudely to someone they should be polite to 顶嘴，回嘴
•Children who talk back are regarded as cheeky and disrespectful.顶嘴的孩子被认为是放肆无礼，对人不尊敬。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs [M] talk sth down
■to talk about something in a way that makes it seem less important or less serious than it really is 贬低；贬抑
•He began his lecture by talking down the initiatives of a rival company.他在讲座一开始就贬低竞争对手的计划。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs [M] talk sb down
PREVENT
■to speak loudly or without stopping to prevent someone else from speaking 以高声（或连续）讲话制止（某人）说话
•I tried to explain, but he just talked me down.我想解释一下，但他一直在滔滔不绝地说着，根本不让我插话。
PERSUADE
■to persuade someone who is threatening to kill themselves not to jump from a high place 劝（企图自杀者）从高处下来
•The policeman talked the girl down after she had been on the roof for two hours.那个女孩在屋顶上两小时后，终于被员警劝了下来。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs talk down to sb
■to talk to someone as if they were less intelligent than you or not important 以居高临下的语气对（某人）说话
•I wish politicians wouldn't talk down to us as if we were idiots.我希望政客们不要以那种居高临下的语气跟我们讲话，好像我们都是白痴似的。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs talk sb into sth
■to persuade someone to do something 说服（某人）做…
•He's against the idea, but I think I can talk him into it.他反对这个主意，不过我觉得我能够说服他接受。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs [M] talk sth out
■to discuss something such as a problem or plan completely in order to find a solution or an agreement 透过协商消除（分歧等）；透过协商解决（问题等）
•If you two don't talk out the differences between you, it'll be very difficult for you to continue working together.你俩如果不好好谈谈消除分歧，将很难继续合作下去。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs talk sb out of sth
■to persuade someone not to do something 说服（某人）放弃
•[+ -ing verb] With some difficulty, he was able to talk his way out of paying the fine.费了一番唇舌后，他终于不用交罚款了。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs [M] talk sth over
■to discuss a problem or situation with someone, often to find out their opinion or to get advice before making a decision about it （在作出决定前）讨论，商量
•I'd like to talk it over with my wife first.我想先跟妻子商量一下。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs talk sb round UK
■to persuade someone to agree with you or to do what you want them to do 说服（某人）
•She's not keen on the idea but we think we can talk her round.她对这个想法不怎么感兴趣，不过我们认为能说服她。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs talk round/around sth
■to avoid speaking directly about something 拐弯抹角地说
•I felt that he just talked round the subject and didn't tackle the main issues.我觉得他只是不着边际地说了一通，没有涉及主要问题。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] verb intransitive
Phrasal Verbs [M] talk sth up
■to speak with enthusiasm about something 热烈地谈论；宣扬
•If we talk up the event, people will surely come.如果我们把这事好好宣传一下，人们一定会来的。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] noun
ESSENTIAL countable
■a conversation between two people, often about a particular subject 交谈
•I asked him to have a talk with his mother about his plan.我叫他跟他母亲谈谈他的计划。
ESSENTIAL countable
■when someone speaks to a group of people about a particular subject 演讲；讲座
•He gave a talk about/on his visit to America.他就他的美国之行举办了一个讲座。
talks [plural]
■serious and formal discussions on an important subject usually intended to produce decisions or agreements 商谈；会谈
•Talks were held in Madrid about the fuel crisis.有关燃料危机的会谈在马德里召开。
uncountable
■when people talk about what might happen or be true, or the subject people are talking about 闲谈；话题
•Talk won't get us anywhere.闲谈对我们毫无益处。
talk 1 2. The talk/Her talk was all about the wedding.
那次谈话／她所说的全都是关于婚礼的事。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] noun
be all talk (and no action) (also be just talk)
■used to describe someone who talks about doing something but never does it 空口说白话，光说不做
•She's all talk when it comes to doing something about the problem.每当要拿出实际行动来解决这问题的时候，她就光说不做。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] noun
be the talk of somewhere
■to be what people are discussing in a particular place 成为（某地）人们谈论的话题
•Her behaviour is the talk of the neighbourhood/office.她的行为举止成了邻里／办公室里谈论的话题。
UK [tɔ:k] US [tɑ:k] noun
be the talk of the town
■to be what everyone is talking about 成为街谈巷议的话题；成为众人的话题
•The new statue in the park is the talk of the town.公园里的新塑像成了镇上人们谈论的焦点。
lecture, speech, oration, address, report, talk
这组词都有“演讲，讲话，报告”的意思，其区别是：
lecture: 侧重带学术性的演讲。
speech: 普通用词，指一般的发言或讲话，可以是事先准备的，也可以是即席的。
oration: 常指在特殊场合，辞藻华丽，形式庄重，旨在激发听众感情的正式演说。
address: 正式用词，指在庄严隆重的场合作精心准备的演讲或正式演说。
report: 一般是指下级给上级或负责人给委托机关的书面或口头报告。
talk: 常用词，强调非正式讲话，讲话方式一般较为自由。
dialogue, conversation, chat, talk
这组词都有“交谈”的意思，其区别是：
dialogue: 指“对话”。
conversation: 一般用词，指两个或更多人互相交换意见的交谈。
chat: 指熟人之间非常随便的交谈，强调谈话的亲密和非正式性。
talk: 普通用词，可与conversation换用，指正式交谈。
state, speak, say, tell, utter, talk
这组词都有“说、讲”的意思，其区别是：
state: 较正式用词，通常指用明确的语言或文字着重地叙述事实，既强调内容又注重语气。
speak: 侧重于说话动作的本身，着重说话的能力而不在内容，可以是长篇大论的演讲，也可以是三言两语的交谈，甚至指简单的开口发声说话。
say: 最普通常用词，指用语言表达思想，着重所说的内容。
tell: 普通用词，指把某事告诉或讲述给某人听，口语或书面语均可用。
utter: 着重说话的行为，常指声音的使用，突出用噪子发声。
talk: 普通用词，侧重指与人交谈时的连续说话，可指单方面较长谈话，和speak一样，着重说活动作而不侧重内容。
vt. 说；谈话；讨论
- quo, tell, observe, debate
vi. 谈话；说闲话
- jerk chin music, dialogize
n. 谈话；演讲；空谈
- speech, address, lecture, discourse

entries.meaning:
adj.驯服的；柔顺的；乏味的
vt.驯养；使驯服；压制
vi.变得驯服
entries.example:
A boy was playing with a tame snake.
一个男孩在玩一条驯服了的蛇。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
A boy was playing with a tame snake.
一个男孩在玩一条驯服了的蛇。

The animals we find in the zoo are quite tame.
我们在动物园看到的动物都很驯服。

It's incredible that the tame wolf is as mild as a lamb.
令人难以置信的是驯服的狼温和如羊。

She is too tame.
她太柔顺了。

I quite enjoyed the book but found the ending rather tame.
我很爱看那本书,只是结尾颇觉乏味。

The Asian elephant can be tamed and trained.
亚洲象可以被驯养和训练。

We are trying to tame a really mad horse.
我们正设法驯服一匹发了疯的马。

She made strenuous efforts to tame her anger.
她竭力压制心头怒火。

That tiger is impossible to tame.
那只老虎难以驯服。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
adj. 驯服的; 平淡的; 无精打采的
v. 驯服; 抑制
时态：tamed, taming, tames
分布：驯服的(40%)，驯养(25%)，乏味的(13%)，使驯服(8%)，压制(6%)，变得驯服(6%)，柔顺的(2%)
→来自古英语 tam,驯服的，畜养的，来自 Proto-Germanic*tamaz,驯服，畜养，来自 deme, 驯服，畜养，来自 dem,家，家园，词源同 domicile,domesticate,adamant.
a.驯服的,温顺的;沉闷的,乏味的vt.驯服The tame tigers play the same game on the frame.温顺的老虎在框架上玩同一游戏.
【反】racy（adj 保持原味的；活泼的）
adjective
NOT WILD 温顺的
ADVANCED
■(especially of animals) not wild or dangerous, either naturally or because of training or long involvement with humans （尤指动物）温顺的，驯化的
•After a few months' contact the monkeys become very tame.经过几个月的接触，那些猴子变得非常温顺了。
[teɪm] adjective
NOT EXCITING 不令人兴奋的 disapproving
■not interesting or exciting 平淡的，乏味的
•It was a tame film in comparison to some that she's made.较她之前拍摄的其他一些影片，这一部显得平淡乏味。
[teɪm] verb transitive
■to make a wild animal tame 驯化，驯服（动物）
■to control something dangerous or powerful 控制，制服；驾驭
•He'll need to tame his temper if he wants to succeed.如果他想取得成功，就得改改自己的脾气。
adj. 驯服的；平淡的；乏味的；顺从的
- stupid, docile
vt. 驯养；使变得平淡；制服
- domesticate, bring under

entries.meaning:
n.棕褐色；黝黑
v.晒黑；鞣(革)；<俚>痛打
adj.棕褐色的
entries.example:
I bought a pair of tan leather shoes the other day.
前几天我买了双棕褐色的皮鞋。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
I bought a pair of tan leather shoes the other day.
前几天我买了双棕褐色的皮鞋。

It took me all summer to get this tan.
我花了整个夏天才晒出这样的棕褐色。

My tan's beginning to fade.
我晒黑的肤色逐渐变浅了。

The skin of your cheeks will tan.
你双颊的皮肤将被晒得黝黑.

Jane tanned quickly in the sun.
简在太阳下很快就晒黑了。

My job is to tan leather in the leather processing company every day.
我在这家皮革加工厂里天天鞣革。

These shoes are tan, not dark brown.
这些鞋是棕黄色的，不是深褐色的。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 黄褐色，棕黄色; 鞣料; 马戏团; 晒黑的皮色
vt. （使）晒成棕褐色; 鞣（革）
vi. 晒成棕褐色
adj. 黄褐色的，棕黄色的; 鞣皮的
时态：tanned, tanning, tans
分布：棕褐色(42%)，晒黑(33%)，棕褐色的(16%)，黝黑(9%)
→来自法语 tan,橡树树皮，来自拉丁语 tannum,橡树树皮，来自 dhonu,橡树，杉木。因过 去用橡树树皮制革而得名，后引申形容词词义褐色的。
n./a.(皮肤因日晒而成)棕褐色(的)vt.晒黑The frank man put the first-rank blank blanket into the tan tank.直率的男子将一流空白毛毯放进黝黑的大容器
【记】鞣革需要tan（炭）火和丹宁酸（tannin）
【参】tanner（n 制革工人）
noun countable (also suntan)
ADVANCED
■when your skin is brown from being in the sun 晒成棕褐色的肤色
•a deep tan晒得黝黑的皮肤
[tæn] adjective noun uncountable
■(a) pale, yellowish brown 棕黄色（的）；棕褐色（的）
[tæn] verb (-nn-)
COLOUR 颜色
ADVANCED intransitive or transitive
■to become brown, or to make someone's body or skin, etc. brown, from being in the sun 晒成棕褐色的肤色
•Her skin tans very quickly in the summer.她的皮肤在夏天很容易晒黑。
•I need to tan my legs before the holiday.我需要把腿晒黑才去渡假。
•Tanned workmen were sitting around the dock.皮肤晒得黑黝黝的工人在码头围坐。
[tæn] verb (-nn-)
LEATHER 皮革
transitive
■to change animal skin into leather using special chemicals such as tannin 鞣（革）；用鞣酸将（兽皮）制成皮革
[tæn] verb (-nn-)
tan sb's hide (UK also tan the hide off sb) old-fashioned
■to beat someone 揍（某人）
•I'll tan his hide if I catch him.如果我抓到他，一定会把他揍扁。
[tæn] abbreviation written abbreviation for
■tangent (TRIANGLE)
tag, tar, tap, tan
tag: 标签，货签；
tar: 柏油，焦油
tap: 水龙头，轻拍，利用，开发；
tan: 晒黑成棕褐色，鞭打；
n. 棕褐色； [皮革] 鞣料；马戏团
- circus, Circus Troupe
adj. 黄褐色的；鞣皮的
- fulvous, snuffcoloured

entries.meaning:
n.箱；罐；槽；贮水池；坦克
vt.把 ... 储于槽中
entries.example:
Is there any water left in the water tank?
水箱里还有水剩下吗？

details.title: 例句
details.text:
Is there any water left in the water tank?
水箱里还有水剩下吗？

The gas is stored under pressure in the tank.
该气体在压缩状态下贮存于罐中。

I need a funnel to pour petrol into the tank.
我需要一个漏斗把汽油灌进油箱。

Gasoline dribbled from the leak in the tank.
汽油从油槽漏隙滴下。

There is some sand in the bottom of the tank.
这水池底部有些沙子。

The tank got bogged down in the mud.
坦克陷入泥沼之中。

A whole tank regiment was completely immobilized by enemy air attacks.
敌军的空袭将整个坦克团完全钳制住了。

Will you tank up my car immediately?
请你立即给我的汽车加满油好吗?

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 油[水]箱; 坦克; 贮水池; 酒量大的人
vt. 把…贮放在柜内; 打败
时态：tanked, tanking, tanks
分布：箱(37%)，罐(30%)，坦克(25%)，槽(5%)，贮水池(2%)，把 ... 储于槽中(1%)
→来自葡萄牙语 tanque,水箱，容器，借自印度语，如印度总理莫迪所在邦古吉拉特语 tankh, 水箱，畜水池，最终可能来自梵语 tadaga,池塘。现主要词义军事坦克来自一战时英国人发 明该重型装甲武器后为出其不意给德军重创，从而以“Tank”作掩护而得名。
n.罐,槽,箱;坦克vt.储于槽中The frank man put the first-rank blank blanket into the tan tank.直率的男子将一流空白毛毯放进黝黑的大容器
noun countable
CONTAINER 容器
ADVANCED
■a container which holds liquid or gas （盛放液体或气体的）容器
•a water tank水箱
•a fuel/petrol tank燃料／汽油箱
[tæŋk] noun countable
VEHICLE 车辆
ADVANCED
■a large military fighting vehicle built to protect those inside it from attack, which is driven by wheels which turn inside moving metal belts 坦克
n. [军] 坦克；水槽；池塘
- trough, mere
vt. 把…贮放在柜内；打败
- beat, best

entries.meaning:
n.龙头；塞子；窃听
n.轻拍；轻敲；鞋掌
v.轻拍；轻击；补鞋掌；选择
v.开发；利用；索要；装龙头；窃听
entries.example:
The water leaked from the tap drop by drop.
水一滴一滴地从龙头漏出来。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
The water leaked from the tap drop by drop.
水一滴一滴地从龙头漏出来。

She left the tap on and the bath ran over.
她没有关水龙头，澡盆里的水溢出来了。

The tap on the cask was dirty.
桶上的塞子很脏。

The police had put a tap on his phone line.
警察在他的电话上装上窃听器。

There was a tap on the window.
有人在轻叩窗户。

The tooth hurts when I tap it.
我轻敲时牙齿会痛。

That girl tapped her fingers on the desk impatiently.
那个女孩不耐烦地用手指轻扣桌面。

Pick an Album, pick a picture, and tap Choose to confirm.
选择一个相册，选择一个图片，并利用选择确认。

No load tap ranges should be selected to provide an adequate low-side bus voltage.
无载分接范围选择应能提供正确的低压侧母线电压。

We should tap natural resources.
我们应该开发自然资源。

Since man is able to tap such resources as oil and metals, why can't he develop and harness other energy resources?
既然人类能开发石油和金属这样的能源,为什么不能开发和利用其他能源呢?

We must tap manpower, land and material resources to the full.
我们要做到人尽其才,地尽所利,物尽所用。

I managed to tap my father for another$10.
我成功地向父亲又要了10美元。

My phone is being tapped.
有人在窃听我的电话。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
vt. 开发; （从容器等）汲取（液体）; 割[打]开…取[放]液体
vi. 轻声走; 跳踢踏舞
n. 龙头，阀门; 塞子; 电话窃听; （补鞋的）掌子
时态：tapped, tapping, taps
分布：龙头(48%)，利用(12%)，开发(11%)，轻拍(8%)，轻敲(6%)，窃听(5%)，选择(3%)，塞子(3%)，轻击(2%)，鞋掌(1%)，索要(1%)
→来自古英语 taeppa,水龙头，塞子，来自 Proto-Germanic*tappon,塞子，词源同 tamp,tampon. 引申词义开发，利用。tap 轻拍，轻击，轻扣
n.塞子;水龙头;n./v.轻打,轻敲;vt.开发The mapper trapped in the gap tapped the tap wrapper with strap.陷在缝中的制图者用皮带轻击塞子套.
verb (-pp-)
HIT 打
intransitive or transitive
■to hit something gently, and often repeatedly, especially making short sharp noises （常指连续）轻拍，轻叩，轻敲
•The branches tapped against the window.树枝轻轻敲打着窗户。
•I could hear him tapping his fingers on the desk.我能听见他用手指轻叩桌子的声音。
•I was tapping my feet (= hitting the floor gently with my feet) to the music.我随着音乐用脚打拍子。
•Someone tapped me on the shoulder.有人轻轻拍我的肩膀。
[tæp] verb (-pp-)
GET 获得
transitive
■to get or make use of something 开发；开辟；着手利用
•For more than a century, Eastern cities have expanded their water supplies by tapping ever more remote sources.一个多世纪以来，东部的城市透过开发更偏远地区的水源，扩大了水的供应。
•There is a rich vein of literary talent here just waiting to be tapped (into) by publishers.众多文学才俊汇聚于此，等待出版商慧眼识珠。
[tæp] verb (-pp-)
TELEPHONE 电话
transitive
■to use a small device fixed to a telephone in order to listen secretly to what people are saying 在（电话或电报线）上装窃听器；窃听
•He suspected that his telephone had been tapped.他怀疑自己的电话被人窃听了。
[tæp] verb (-pp-)
Phrasal Verbs tap sb for sth old-fashioned informal
■to get money from someone 从（某人）处获得（钱）
•I might be able to tap my father for a loan.我也许能从我父亲那里借到钱。
[tæp] noun
DEVICE 设备
IMPROVER countable UK (US faucet)
■a device that controls the flow of liquid, especially water, from a pipe （水）龙头，阀门
•the hot/cold tap热水／冷水龙头
•Turn the tap on/off.打开／关掉水龙头
IMPROVER countable UK
■a device that controls the flow of gas from a pipe （煤气）阀门
on tap
■describes beer which is served from a barrel through a tap （啤酒）装在有旋塞的桶里的，散装的
■available for use at any time 随时可用的
•Working in a library as I do, I have all this information on tap.我在图书馆工作，可以随时查阅所有这些资料。
[tæp] noun
HIT 打
countable
■a gentle knock or touch, or the noise made by knocking something gently 轻扣，轻敲，轻拍；轻轻拍打（或敲击）的声响
•I gave her a tap on the shoulder and she turned round.我轻轻拍了一下她的肩，她回过头来。
•There was a tap on the window - Dad was outside!有人轻轻敲了一下窗子－－是爸爸在外面！
[tæp] noun
DANCE 舞蹈
uncountable
■tap dancing 踢踏舞
•He teaches tap and ballroom.他教人跳踢踏舞和社交舞。
[tæp] noun
TELEPHONE 电话
countable
■a small piece of equipment that can be fixed to a telephone in order to listen secretly to someone's telephone calls 在（电话或电报线）上装窃听器；窃听
•He claims that he knew nothing of government phone taps on journalists during those years.他宣称自己对那几年政府监听记者电话的事一无所知。
pat, knock, rap, tap
这组词都有“敲、击”的意思，其区别是：
pat: 指用手轻拍以示同情、赞同或爱抚。
knock: 指用拳头或其它器械猛敲或猛打；也指用手轻敲某物。
rap: 指用手指或木棒等快速地轻敲或急拍。
tap: 多指慢慢地连续地轻击或轻拍。
tag, tar, tap, tan
tag: 标签，货签；
tar: 柏油，焦油
tap: 水龙头，轻拍，利用，开发；
tan: 晒黑成棕褐色，鞭打；
vt. 轻敲；轻打；装上嘴子
- percuss
vi. 轻拍；轻击；轻叩
- pat
n. 水龙头；轻打
- water faucet, rotary swivel

entries.meaning:
n.磁带；胶布；终点
v.录音；录像；用胶布粘；用绳子捆绑；用卷尺测量
entries.example:
I've got all the Beethoven symphonies on tape.
我有贝多芬交响乐全部的录音带。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
I've got all the Beethoven symphonies on tape.
我有贝多芬交响乐全部的录音带。

Cassette tape recorders are gradually out of date now.
现在,盒式磁带录音机渐渐过时了。

You'd better put some insulating tape on electric wires.
你最好给电线裹上绝缘胶布。

The two runners broke the tape together.
两位赛跑运动员在终点同时撞线。

I taped a late-night radio show and listened to it in the morning.
我录下午夜的收音机节目,早上听。

Shall I tie the package or tape it?
我把这个包裹捆起来还是贴胶带?

The doctor has taped up my swollen ankle.
医生用绷带把我肿起的脚踝包扎起来。

Wrap a tape measure around your waist at the level of your navel.
在腰部的肚脐水平位置用卷尺测量腰围。

The first step is an accurate measurement of the walls that are to be covered.Use a yardstick or steel tape measure.
第一步就是精确测量被覆盖了的墙面，使用标尺或者钢卷尺测量。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 带子; 胶带，磁带; 卷尺
vt. 用带子捆起来; 录音
vt. & vi. 录音
时态：taped, taping, tapes
分布：磁带(50%)，录音(36%)，录像(7%)，胶布(4%)，终点(1%)，用卷尺测量(1%)，用胶布粘(1%)
→来自古英语 taeppe,小布条，布带，可能来自拉丁语 tapete,布料，毯子，来自希腊语 tapes,纺 织品，布料，毯子，来自 temp,拉，伸，来自 ten,拉，伸，词源同 extend,tense.引申 诸相关词义。
n.带(子);录音带,磁带v.录音;系,捆Can I borrow your tape?能借你的磁带听吗?
noun countable or uncountable
RECORDING 录音
IMPROVER
■thin plastic in a long narrow strip with a magnetic covering which allows sounds or sounds and pictures to be recorded and played again, or a cassette , especially one on which sound is (to be) recorded 磁带，录音带，录像带
•magnetic tape磁带
•I've got that film on tape (= recorded) if you want to borrow it.我已经把那部电影录了下来，你可以借去看。
•If you give me a blank tape (= one with nothing on it) I'll record it for you.如果你给我一张空白带，我就帮你录。
[teɪp] noun countable or uncountable
STRIP 条带
■a long narrow strip of material which is sometimes sticky on one side 带子，胶带
•UK sticky tape胶带
the (finishing) tape
■a tape stretched across the finishing line of a race which the winner breaks as they finish 终点线
[teɪp] verb transitive
RECORD 唱片
■to record something on tape 把…录在录音带（或录像带）上
[teɪp] verb transitive
USE STICKY STRIPS 使用胶布
■to use strips of sticky material, especially to fix two things together or to fasten a parcel 用胶布固定；用胶布封住；用带子捆扎
•She taped a note to the door.她把一张字条贴在门上。
[teɪp] verb transitive
have sb taped (also have sb on tape) UK informal
■to know about and be able to deal with a person or situation 摸清（某人）的底细
n. 胶带； [计] 磁带；带子；卷尺
- magnetictape, mylar
vt. 录音；用带子捆扎；用胶布把…封住
- sound recording, make a record

entries.meaning:
n.任务；工作
vt.交给某人（任务)；使做艰苦的工作
entries.example:
It is an irksome task.
那是件令人厌烦的工作。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
It is an irksome task.
那是件令人厌烦的工作。

Her work is a laborious task.
她的工作很艰苦。

This is a task well within your ability.
这完全是你力所能及的工作。

We should devote all our efforts to task.
我们应该全力以赴地工作。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 工作，任务; 作业; 苦差事
vt. 交给某人（任务）; 使过于劳累
时态：tasked, tasking, tasks
分布：任务(77%)，工作(22%)，使做艰苦的工作(1%)
→来自古法语方言 tasque,税收，税费，置换自拉丁语 taxa,估价，估税，收税，来自 taxare,评 估，估计，来自 tag,接触，安排，词源同 tax,tangent.后用于指以劳动或劳务代替应交税 款，再后引申词义分派的任务，目的等。
n.任务,作业,工作The man in mask asked me for a task; I let him put the basket on the desk in the dusk.戴面具的人向我要任务,我让他在黄昏时把篮子放到桌子上.
US [tæsk] noun
WORK 工作
ESSENTIAL countable
■a piece of work to be done, especially one done regularly, unwillingly or with difficulty 任务；（尤指经常、不情愿或很难做的）工作；（苦）差事
•We usually ask interviewees to perform a few simple tasks on the computer just to test their aptitude.我们通常让接受面试人士在电脑上进行一些简单操作，只想测测他们的能力。
•The government now faces the daunting task of restructuring the entire health service.政府现在面临重新改组整个医疗卫生体系的艰巨任务。
UK [tɑ:sk] US [tæsk] noun
SPEAK ANGRILY 怒斥
take sb to task
■to criticize or speak angrily to someone for something that they have done wrong 责备（某人）
•She took her assistant to task for/over her carelessness.她责备助手太粗心大意。
UK [tɑ:sk] US [tæsk] verb transitive usually passive
■to give someone a task 派给…任务
•We have been tasked with setting up camps for refugees.我们接到了建难民营的任务。
assignment, task, profession, job
assignment: 指分派做的特定任务，也指长期性工作
task: 被派或自愿承担工作，尤指困难、辛劳的工作
profession: 指从事脑力劳动，经过特殊培训的“职业”，如老师
job: 常指短期任务
work, task, job
这组词都有“工作”的意思，其区别是：
work: 最普通用词，含义广，指人们日常生活和工作中所从事的有目的的体力或脑力劳动。
task: 通常指分派给的任务，也指自愿的工作，但往往是艰巨或令人厌烦的工作。
job: 多用于口语，侧重指受雇用的，以谋生为目的工作，不论有无技术，也不管是零工或散工。
n. 工作，作业； [计] 任务
- job, work, role, pursuit, labor

entries.meaning:
n.味觉；味道；尝试；品味；爱好
v.品尝；有 ... 味道的；体验
entries.example:
I've got a cold and so I have lost my sense of taste.
我伤风了,尝不出味道。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
I've got a cold and so I have lost my sense of taste.
我伤风了,尝不出味道。

The medicine has a bitter taste.
这药有苦味。

She likes her first taste of life in a big city.
她喜欢她对大城市生活的初次体验。

She has good taste in clothes.
她对服装有很好的审美眼光。

They have not at least been given a taste for nature in early life.
至少,他们在少年时期没有受到爱好自然的培养。

That's the best wine I've ever tasted.
那是我喝过的最好的酒

This soup tastes of chicken.
这汤里有鸡肉的味道。

It's been 13 years since they last tasted victory.
我们已经有13年没有体验胜利的滋味了。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 体验; 滋味; 味觉; 风味
vt. & vi. 尝，品尝
vt. 吃; 喝; 浅尝
vi. 尝味; 略进（饮食）; （少量地）吃; 有某种味道
时态：tasted, tasting, tastes
分布：味道(49%)，品尝(20%)，品味(13%)，味觉(6%)，爱好(5%)，体验(5%)，尝试(1%)，有 ... 味道的(1%)
→来自拉丁语 tangere,接触，触摸，-st,过去分词反复格，词源同 tangent,tax.引申词义品尝，引 申词义味道，滋味等。
v.品尝;(of)有...味道;体验n.滋味;味觉I don't like the taste of this meat.我不喜欢这块肉的味道.
noun
FLAVOUR 味道
ESSENTIAL countable or uncountable
■the flavour of something, or the ability of a person or animal to recognize different flavours 味道；味觉
•I love the taste of garlic.我喜欢蒜味。
•I didn't like red wine before but I acquired a taste for it (= started to like it as I became familiar with it) while I was living in France.我以前不喜欢喝红酒，但在法国生活期间我渐渐喜欢上了它。
•Olives are perhaps an acquired taste (= you only like them after you have become familiar with their taste).橄榄的味道可能要慢慢习惯才会喜欢。
⇒ See also aftertaste
ADVANCED only singular
■a small amount of food 少许，一点
•Have a taste of the sauce and tell me if it needs salt.尝尝酱汁，看看是否需要加盐。
[teɪst] noun
JUDGMENT 判断
ADVANCED countable or uncountable
■a person's approval of and liking for particular things （个人的）兴趣，爱好
•I've never really cared much for flash new cars - old vintage cars are more to my taste (= what I like).我一向不怎么喜欢豪华的新款车——倒是更喜欢老式汽车。
ADVANCED uncountable approving
■a person's ability to judge and recognise what is good or suitable, especially relating to such matters as art, style, beauty and behaviour 鉴赏力，审美力；品味
•He has the most awful taste so you can probably imagine what his house looks like.他的品味极差，你大概可以想像出他家是甚么样子。
•His taste in clothes leaves a little to be desired.他的着装品味实在不怎么样。
•He told a joke about death that I thought was in rather poor taste considering that Steve's father had just died.他讲了一个关于死亡的笑话，我觉得在史蒂夫的父亲刚去世不久就说这样的笑话很不得体。
tastes [plural]
■the things a person likes 爱好，（个人）喜欢的事物
•I'm afraid I have expensive tastes (= I like expensive things).我看来是喜欢奢华的东西。
[teɪst] noun
EXPERIENCE 经历
only singular
■a short experience of something 短暂的体验
•I had a taste of office work during the summer and that was quite enough.那年夏天我体验了一下在办公室工作的滋味，可真够我受的。
[teɪst] verb transitive
FOOD/DRINK 食物／饮料
ESSENTIAL
■to put food or drink in your mouth to find out what flavour it has 尝…的味道
•Taste this sauce and tell me if it needs seasoning.尝尝酱汁，看看要不要加佐料。
•Whatever's this? I've never tasted anything like it.这究竟是甚么东西？我从没吃过这种东西。
taste good/bad/sweet, etc.
IMPROVER
■to have a particular flavour 吃起来好吃／难吃／甜等
•This sauce tastes strange.这种酱汁味道很怪。
•The bread tastes of onions.这面包有股洋葱味。
•This coffee tastes like dishwater!这咖啡的味道简直像洗碗水！
[teɪst] verb transitive
EXPERIENCE 经历
■to experience something for a short time （短暂）体验，经历，领略
•Once you've tasted luxury it's very hard to settle for anything else.你一旦体验过奢侈的滋味，就很难将就了。
n. [食品] 味道；品味；审美
- uner, aesthetic appreciation
vt. 尝；体验
- experience, degustate

entries.meaning:
n.税；负担
v.斥责；课税；使 ... 负重荷
entries.example:
She was fined for tax evasion.
她因逃税而被罚款。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
She was fined for tax evasion.
她因逃税而被罚款。

The care of six children is a tax on her energy.
照料六个孩子成了她精力上很大的负担。

Climbing stairs is a tax on a weak heart.
爬楼梯对于心脏功能不强的人来说是一个沉重的负担。

He was taxed with neglecting the safety regulations.
他由于忽视安全操作规程而受到责备。

Tobacco and alcoholic drinks are taxed heavily in their country.
烟酒在他们的国家都被课以重税。

This crossword will really tax your brain.
这纵横字谜真能让人大伤脑筋。

All these questions are beginning to tax my patience.
所有这些问题逐渐使我不胜其烦。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
vt. 使负重担; 消耗精力; 向…征税; 责备，谴责
n. 税，税额; 负担
时态：taxed, taxing, taxes
分布：税(96%)，负担(2%)，课税(1%)，斥责(1%)
→来自拉丁语 taxare,评估，估计，征税，反复格于 tangere,接触，安排，来自 tag,接触， 触摸，词源同 tangent,task.后引申词义征税，课税，及名词词义税收，税款等。
n.税(款),负担v.对...征税,使负重担Axe the tax on taxis. Wax may relax the body.削减出租车的税费.蜂蜡可以使身体放松.
noun countable or uncountable
ESSENTIAL
■(an amount of) money paid to the government, which is based on your income or the cost of goods or services you have bought 税；税款
•They're putting up the tax on cigarettes.他们要提高烟草税。
•Tax cuts (= reductions in taxes) are always popular.减税总是受欢迎的。
•What do you earn before/after tax (= before/after you have paid tax on the money you earn) ?你的税前／税后收入是多少？
[tæks] verb transitive
MONEY 钱
ADVANCED
■to make someone pay a tax 对…征税，对…课税
•Husbands and wives may be taxed independently/together.夫妻俩可以分别／合并纳税。
[tæks] verb transitive
NEED EFFORT 需要努力
■to need someone to make a lot of effort, either physical or mental 使负重担；使大伤脑筋
•He only has to read a short report - it shouldn't tax him unduly.他只需读一篇简短的报告——这应该不会耗费他太多精力。
tax, duty, tariff, assess, dues, impose
tax: 普通用词，指用各种不同方法向个人或单位征收所得税、房地产税等各种税款。侧重实际征收金钱。
duty: 责任
tariff: 关税
assess: 指一般情况下，征收房地产税、罚款或其它费用。
dues: 会费
impose: 指在决定个别案件中的处罚或罚款，尤指政府征收某种税收的决定。
n. 税金；重负
- scot, heavy burden

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
n. 茶水; 茶; 茶树; 午后小吃
vt. 给…沏茶
vi. 喝茶
分布：茶(85%)，茶叶(8%)，茶树(5%)，茶点(2%)
→来自马来语 teh,据说是来自厦门闽南语 t'e,原先拼做 chaa,最终来自汉语茶。
n.茶(叶);午后茶点I nearly fear to tear the tearful girl's test paper.我几乎害怕撕那个泪流满面的女孩的试卷.
noun
DRINK 饮料
ESSENTIAL countable or uncountable
■(a drink made by pouring hot water onto) dried and cut leaves and sometimes flowers, especially the leaves of the tea plant 茶；茶叶
•China/Indian tea中国／印度茶
•iced/lemon tea冰茶／柠檬茶

•I'd love a cup of tea, please.请给我来一杯茶。
•"Shall I pour the tea?" "No, let it brew (= get stronger) a while."“要我把茶倒上吗？”“不用，再泡一会儿。”
•Tea and biscuits will be provided at 11 o'clock.11点会提供茶点。

countable

•Two teas, please.请来两杯茶。
[ti:] noun

ADVANCED uncountable
■a meal that is eaten in the early evening and is usually cooked 午后餐
uncountable

tea and sympathy old-fashioned

•It's time for action, not just tea and sympathy.是采取行动的时候了，光有安慰和同情是不够的。

■used to say that nothing could persuade you to do something 绝对不做，无论如何都不做
•I wouldn't take that job for all the tea in China.我决不会去做那个工作。
n. 茶叶；茶树；茶点

entries.meaning:
vt.教；教导；教授；教训
vi.给予指导
entries.example:
I taught her to ride a bicycle.
我教她骑自行车。

details.title: 例句
details.text:
I taught her to ride a bicycle.
我教她骑自行车。

His parents employed a tutor to teach him Greek.
他父母雇佣了一位家庭教师来教他希腊语。

Parents should teach their children table manners.
双亲应该教导他们的小孩餐桌礼仪。

I've been invited to teach Chinese at the University of New York for one year.
我应聘去纽约大学讲授一年汉语。

I'll teach you to call me a liar!
你说我说谎，我就要教训你！

My purpose is to teach them a lesson.
我的目的是给他们一个教训。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
vt. 教; 教导，训练; 教授
vi. 教书
时态：taught, teaching, teaches
分布：教(77%)，教导(9%)，教训(7%)，教授(6%)，给予指导(1%)
→来自古英语 taecan,指出，展示，教导，来自 Proto-Germanic*taikijan,展示，指出，来自 deik, 展示，指出，词源同 dictionary,token.现主要用于教育相关词义。
vt.教,讲授;教导(训)vi.讲课,当教师The preacher preached to the teacher's teacup.传教士对着老师的茶杯说教.
(taught, taught)
verb intransitive or transitive
ESSENTIAL
■to give someone knowledge or to train someone; to instruct 教；教授；传授
•She taught English to foreign students.她给外国学生讲授英语。
•[+ to infinitive] Who taught you to cook?谁教你做饭的？
teach school US
■to be a teacher in a school 在学校教书
•Ever since she was a child her dream has been to teach school.从童年时起，去学校教书便一直是她的梦想。
[ti:tʃ] (taught, taught)
verb intransitive or transitive
teach sb a lesson
■A person or experience that teaches you a lesson improves your future behaviour by making you experience the bad effects of your actions 教训（某人）；使吸取教训
•Having my car stolen really taught me a lesson - I'll never leave it unlocked again.我的车被盗的确给了我一个教训——我再也不会不锁车了。
•She decided to teach the boy a lesson.她决定教训那个男孩一顿。
[ti:tʃ] (taught, taught)
verb intransitive or transitive
that'll teach sb
■If someone says that they or an unpleasant experience will teach someone (not) to do something, they mean that they will stop that person from doing it in future by making them experience the bad effects of their action 这下（某人）该知道（做某事的）后果了，这下（某人）该知道（不应做某事了）
•So Roger spent the night in a freezing garage, did he? That'll teach him to (= show him that he should not) go out without his house keys!这么说罗杰在冷冰冰的车库里过了一夜是吗？这下他该知道出去不带房门锁匙的后果了吧！
[ti:tʃ] (taught, taught)
verb intransitive or transitive
Common Learner Errors teachWarning: Check your verb endings!Many learners make mistakes when using teach in the past tense.The past simple and past participle are taught. Don't write 'teached', write taught.
instruct, coach, tutor, train, teach, educate
这组词都有“教，教育，培养”的意思，其区别是：
instruct: 与teach含义很接近，但语体较正式。指系统、详细、精心地传播知识，侧重教授与指示。
coach: 指对个人或小组等进行辅导、训练或补课。
tutor: 指进行个别教学或课外辅导。
train: 指训练与培养。
teach: 最普通用词，含义广泛。指直接教某人知识或技能等，侧重传播知识和帮助应用知识。
educate: 较正式用词，指教育，内容比teach广泛，侧重动机或结果，或对潜在能力的开发。
vt. 教；教授；教导
- wise, enlighten

entries.meaning:

vi.流泪；撕破
n.眼泪；（撕破的）洞或裂缝；撕扯
entries.example:

把书从艾丽斯那拿开，她会撕了它的。

details.title: 例句
details.text:

把书从艾丽斯那拿开，她会撕了它的。

突出的钉子会刮坏你的衣服。

唐谈论起他的儿子就开始哭。

Don't pull the pages so hard or they will tear.

My wife burst into tears when she heard the bad news.
我太太听到这个坏消息就哭了起来。

They steal handkerchiefs, they tear off buttons, and they even cut off pieces of the unfortunate singers' hair.
他们偷歌手的手帕，撕扯纽扣，甚至会剪下歌手的头发。

details.title: 卡片背面 · 词典摘录
details.text:
v. 撕裂; 拉掉; 挣开; 拉伤
n. 破洞; 裂口
时态：tore, torn, tearing, tears
分布：眼泪(49%)，撕掉(18%)，撕破(12%)，流泪(8%)，扯下(7%)，扰乱(3%)，撕扯(3%)
→来自古英语 tear,眼泪，来自 Proto-Germanic*tagr,眼泪，来自 dakru,眼泪，词源同 lachrymose, 流泪的。字母 d,l 音变，中间字母 g 脱落。tear 撕裂，撕碎
n.(pl.)眼泪vt.撕裂;使...分裂vi.破裂I nearly fear to tear the tearful girl's test paper.我几乎害怕撕那个泪流满面的女孩的试卷.
【记】我们熟悉的是“眼泪”的意思，但是要记住“撕裂”的意思。
【反】tether（v 用绳锁栓住）；stabilize（v 稳定）
US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
PULL APART 分开
ADVANCED intransitive or transitive
■to pull or be pulled apart, or to pull pieces off （被）撕开，（被）撕掉，（被）撕裂
•You have to be very careful with books this old because the paper tends to tear very easily.对这么旧的书你得格外小心，因为它的纸张很容易撕破。
•I tore my skirt on the chair as I stood up.我站起来时，裙子被椅子钩破了。
•A couple of pages had been torn out of / from the book.这本书有几页被人撕掉了。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
HURRY 赶快
intransitive + adverb or preposition informal
■to move very quickly 狂奔；疾驰；匆忙行动
•He went tearing along the road after the bus.他在路上飞奔追赶公车。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
be in a tearing hurry UK old-fashioned
■to be going somewhere very quickly, usually because you are late 匆忙赶路
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
tear your hair out
■If you tear your hair out over a problem, you are worrying a lot about it （为…）焦虑
•She's been tearing her hair out over the final chapter of her novel for the last month.一个月来，她绞尽脑汁构思小说的最后一章。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
tear sb's heart out
■to make someone very sad 使（某人）心如刀绞
•The thought of those poor, hungry children is tearing my heart out.想起那些贫穷、饥饿的孩子，我心如刀绞。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
tear a strip off sb (also tear sb off a strip) UK informal
■to criticize someone in a forceful way 把…批得体无完肤
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
Phrasal Verbs [M] tear sth apart
PULL VIOLENTLY
■to pull something so violently that it breaks into two or more pieces 把…撕开（或撕成碎片）
•A dog can tear a rabbit apart in seconds.狗片刻就能把一只兔子撕烂。
DIVIDE PEOPLE
■to make a group of people that was united, such as a country, family or political party, argue or fight with each other by dividing it into two or more parts 使…分裂
•Ethnic rivalries threaten to tear this country apart.种族对立使这个国家面临分裂的危险。
•[R] He resigned, depressed at the way that the party was tearing it self apart.由于对党内正在发生的分裂倍感忧虑，他辞职了。
DESTROY
■to destroy a building or room 摧毁；拆毁
•The blast had torn the building apart.爆炸摧毁了该建筑。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
Phrasal Verbs [M] tear sb/sth apart
■to criticize something or someone severely 严厉批评
•The speaker was applauded as he tore apart the prime minister's policies.发言者严厉批评首相的政策，获得一片掌声。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
Phrasal Verbs tear sb apart informal
■to make someone very unhappy 使（某人）非常不快，使（某人）极其难受
•Seeing the children suffer really tears me apart.看到孩子们受苦，我非常难受。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
Phrasal Verbs tear sb away
■to make someone stop doing something that they enjoy, usually because they have to go somewhere or do something else 使（某人）依依不舍地离开；把（某人）拽走
•I'll bring Tim, if I can tear him away from the football.如果我能把蒂姆从足球场上拉出来，我会带他来。
•[R] You could come to the party with us. That's if you can tear your self away from that new boyfriend of yours!你可以和我们一起去参加晚会。只是你得舍得和你那个新男友分开哟！
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
Phrasal Verbs [M] tear sth down
■to intentionally destroy a building or other structure because it is not being used or it is not wanted any more 推倒，拆毁
•They're going to tear down the old hospital and build a new one.他们要拆掉旧医院，再建个新的。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
Phrasal Verbs tear into sb informal
■to criticize someone or something very strongly 严厉批评；猛烈抨击
•Unfortunately, if he doesn't agree with you, he tends to tear into you.遗憾的是，如果他不同意你的意见，往往就会狠狠地批评你。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
Phrasal Verbs [M] tear sth off
■to remove your clothes quickly and carelessly 迅速脱掉（衣服）
•I tore my sweaty clothes off and jumped into the shower.我匆忙脱下被汗水湿透的衣服，跳进淋浴间。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
Phrasal Verbs tear off informal
■to leave very quickly 迅速离开
•He got in his car and tore off down the road.他钻进汽车，疾驰而去。
UK [teər] US [ter] verb (tore, torn)
Phrasal Verbs [M] tear sth up
PAPER
ADVANCED
■to tear paper into a lot of small pieces 撕碎（纸张）
•He tore the letter up and threw it away.他把信撕碎扔掉了。
AGREEMENT
■If you tear up an agreement, you refuse to accept it or be controlled by it any more 撕毁（协议等）
•She tore up the contract and walked out.她撕毁合约，然后退席离开。
UK [teər] US [ter] noun
countable
■a hole in a piece of paper, cloth or other material, where it has been torn 裂口；裂缝
UK [tɪər] US [tɪr] noun
